services.mechanism: Template chosen before recording (요점 정리, 회의록, 강의 노트 incl. review questions) and changeable after; contextual grammar correction; PDF export; password-protected sharing.
services.integration: No public API found; PDF export and link sharing only.
services.pricing_status: Free consumer service; beta launched 2025-06-30 (100 min per recording, 600 min/month at beta); A. has ~10M users.
services.takeaway_for_crata: '녹음 전에 용도 템플릿을 고르고 녹음 후에도 바꾸는' UX와 강의노트 복습문제 생성은 강의·워크샵 사업부 산출물 설계에 참고할 만합니다. 개인용이고 API가 없어 기업 파이프라인 부품으로는 맞지 않습니다.

verification.note: Beta 2025-06-30 with 100 min per recording and 600 min/month confirmed (etoday). SKT planned an official launch by end-2025, so 'beta' limits may be outdated. Call summaries can be moved into A.노트. PDF and share only; no API.

services.name: 갤럭시 AI 녹음 텍스트 변환(Transcript Assist) / Samsung Notes
services.what_it_does: Voice Recorder (and Samsung Notes) on Galaxy S24+/Z Fold6/Flip6 and later transcribes recordings, labels speakers (Speaker 1, 2…), translates, and produces bullet summaries with timecodes.
services.mechanism: Galaxy AI transcription with speaker identification; summary bullets linked to timestamps; manual speaker renaming.
services.korean_support: Supported (Korean is a Galaxy AI language)
services.takeaway_for_crata: 플라우드 대신 쓰거나 같이 쓸 수 있는 녹음 수단이지만, 자동 분류와 API가 없어 파이프라인 부품으로는 약합니다. 학맞통 상담처럼 민감한 대화는 '기기에서만 처리' 설정 가능 여부를 확인한 뒤 1차 녹음 수단으로 검토할 수 있습니다.

verification.note: The cited Samsung Gulf page lists Fold6/Flip6 with speaker identification, translation and summaries. The S24 support and timecode details are not on that page. No API.

services.name: 두레이 (Dooray) / 두레이 AI
services.what_it_does: All-in-one collaboration (mail, messenger, video conferencing, projects) with Dooray AI and AI agents; supplied to ~150 public institutions and to central ministries/local governments via the PPP administrative-network zone (2026-03).
services.mechanism: Calls ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude by API without storing or training on customer data; DLP guardrail blocks sensitive data from entering prompts; 3-layer privacy architecture (infrastructure / export / usage control); Extension Agent for enterprise data integration.
services.integration: Multi-LLM API; Extension Agent; public PPP cloud. A dedicated AI meeting-minutes feature was not confirmed.
services.pricing_status: Active. CSAP 표준등급 and CSA STAR Gold; won the PIPC chair award at the 2026 privacy tech awards (2026-10-01); public-sector AX services planned for Q4 2026.
services.takeaway_for_crata: '인프라·반출·사용 통제' 3계층 구조와 프롬프트 DLP는 CRATA가 학맞통용 아라 에이전트를 설계할 때 그대로 차용할 보안 아키텍처 레퍼런스입니다. 학생 이름·건강·복지 정보를 LLM에 넣기 전에 마스킹하는 식입니다. 공공 고객이 두레이를 쓰면 회의 결과를 두레이 프로젝트로 보내는 연동이 필요합니다.

verification.note: CSAP standard grade, ~150 public institutions, DLP guardrail, 3-layer protection, the PIPC award and the PPP administrative-network supply (announced 2026-03-09, pending NIS review around April) are all confirmed. No dedicated meeting-minutes feature found.

services.name: 플로우 (flow)
services.what_it_does: Project-centric collaboration tool with AI summaries/reports for meetings and work sharing, auto project creation from natural language or documents, and a project-design AI agent; official app in ChatGPT and Claude.
services.mechanism: Project design agent (2026-02-24) analyzes a stated purpose or uploaded Excel WBS/planning docs and generates the overall structure, detailed task list and schedule flow (claims 80%+ planning time saved). MCP exposes 39 functions (project search, task creation, assignee, status, comments, schedules).
services.integration: MCP official app in ChatGPT and Claude (launched 2026-06-25; 1M+ AI calls in 3 months); SaaS and on-premise (구축형).
services.pricing_status: Active; 2025 bookings ₩21B, turned profitable; 5,500+ enterprise customers incl. Samsung affiliates, Hyundai Mobis, S-OIL, KOGAS, LH, KRX.
services.takeaway_for_crata: Goal A에서 '분류 후 라우팅'의 목적지로 가장 현실적입니다. Claude가 회의록을 사업부/프로젝트별로 나눈 뒤 flow MCP로 해당 프로젝트에 업무·담당자·일정을 바로 만들 수 있습니다. 'WBS·기획문서 → 프로젝트 구조 자동 설계'는 Goal B에서 고객사 업무사이트의 메뉴·업무 골격을 자동으로 만드는 방식의 직접적인 레퍼런스입니다.

verification.note: Official ChatGPT and Claude app with 39 functions is confirmed, but 2026-06-25 is the MCP unveiling date, not the registration date (article dated 2026-09-17). 5,500+ corporate clients confirmed. The ₩21B in 2025 bookings and the profitability claim could not be verified (platum returned 403). The project-design AI agent is confirmed (2026-02-24).

services.name: 잔디 (JANDI) / 스프링클러 AI · 잔디홈
services.what_it_does: Messenger-based collaboration with AI 'Sprinkler' (search, context summary, document analysis, 14-language translation) and JANDI Home (2025-08-22), a personalized dashboard that summarizes unread messages by topic.
services.mechanism: LLM summarization grouped by topic on a personal dashboard.
services.integration: Listed on AWS Marketplace; no dedicated AI meeting-minutes feature found.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 회의록 기능은 없어 부품으로는 맞지 않습니다. 다만 '주제별 요약 대시보드(잔디홈)'는 고객사 업무사이트의 홈 화면(오늘 내 프로젝트별 회의·결정 요약)을 설계할 때 참고할 만합니다.

verification.note: JANDI Home launched 2025-08-22 with AI topic-based summaries of unread messages. Sprinkler launched 2025-03-06 on the Intelligence plan. The 14-language and ~5,000 paid-customer figures were not verified. MCP is planned. No meeting-minutes feature.

services.name: 스윗 스냅 (Swit Snap) / Swit 오토메이션
services.what_it_does: Work AI inside Swit: multi-LLM Q&A, automatic conversion of text into team tasks, progress and channel summaries, drafting, rephrasing and translation; plus no-code automation (up to 11 steps).
services.mechanism: Selectable LLMs (GPT, Llama, Solar); chatbot answers can be shared to channels or turned into tasks.
services.integration: Swit Automation connects internal functions and external apps.
services.pricing_status: Active; claims HIPAA/SOC2 compliance and no training on user data.
services.takeaway_for_crata: '대화나 요약 텍스트를 클릭 한 번에 팀 업무로 전환'하는 UX는 회의 분류 결과를 사람이 확인하고 업무로 확정하는 화면을 설계할 때 참고할 만합니다. 국내 공공·교육 레퍼런스는 확인되지 않았습니다.

verification.note: Multi-LLM (GPT, Llama, Solar), task recommendation from text, summaries, HIPAA/SOC2 and no training on user data confirmed. Automation supports up to 11 steps (launched 2023-07-18).

services.name: 카카오워크 2.0
services.what_it_does: Kakao Work 2.0 (launched 2026-07-14) adds channels/threads and Work AI: sentence refinement, unread and mention summaries, an AI side panel to search past chats and ask about files, and AI chat-room grouping.
services.mechanism: 'AI 채팅방 그룹': AI automatically groups chat rooms with similar topics based on room names and recent conversations.
services.integration: WorkAI agent, internal-policy search AI; no public meeting-notes API found.
services.pricing_status: Active; operated by DK Techin; rebuilt on Electron/Rust with large performance gains.
services.takeaway_for_crata: '방 이름 + 최근 대화로 주제별 자동 그룹핑'은 Goal A의 간단한 첫 구현 패턴으로 쓸 수 있습니다. 회의 제목, 캘린더 일정명, 앞부분 발화를 함께 넣어 임베딩 유사도로 사업부를 추정하는 방식입니다.

verification.note: Unveiled 2026-07-14 by DK Techin. AI chat-room grouping, unread and mention summaries, and sentence refinement confirmed; needs the Mini plan or higher. Correction: the app migrated from Electron to Rust; it was not 'built on Electron/Rust'.

services.name: 다우오피스 AI
services.what_it_does: Groupware AI: attachment summaries (meeting minutes, reports), a chatbot trained on board and document data, and 'Daou Office AI' (2026-08), a 1:1 assistant over internal documents, mail, reports and meeting materials tailored to each company's environment.
services.mechanism: RAG over groupware data with role-based access; customer data not used for training. Meeting minutes come from external AI tools, then action items become tasks with deadlines and minutes attach to e-approval.
services.integration: Groupware-internal (calendar, tasks, e-approval, messenger); no own STT found.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 한국 중소·중견기업은 '회의록 → 업무 → 결재' 흐름이 그룹웨어에 묶여 있습니다. 그래서 고객사 업무사이트를 만들 때 결재선·게시판·문서함 구조가 그 회사의 의사결정 패턴을 보여주는 핵심 데이터원이 됩니다.

verification.note: Daou Office AI assistant launched 2026-08-04. Attachment summaries and the board/document chatbot confirmed (2025-10-20). The 'Action Item→task' and e-approval link comes from a Daou blog workflow that uses external tools (Clova Note, Callabo, etc.); it is not a native AI meeting feature. No own STT.

services.name: 릴리스AI (Lilys AI)
services.what_it_does: Summarizes video, audio, PDFs and websites; real-time meeting notes that emit a transcript and summary every minute; speaker identification, timestamps, translation; enterprise video-summary API (2024-07) aimed at edtech and corporate training.
services.mechanism: Real-time STT + incremental LLM summarization; contextual term explanation in notes.
services.pricing_status: Active; consumer subscription; API pricing undisclosed.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 강의·워크샵 사업부에서 강의 녹화/녹음을 요약노트·복습자료로 만드는 산출물 설계에 참고할 만합니다. 회의 자동 분류나 보안 요구에는 맞지 않습니다.

verification.note: Enterprise summary API (2024-07-23) for edtech and corporate training, and real-time meeting minutes (2024-01), confirmed. The 'every minute' interval and speaker identification were not confirmed in the cited articles.

services.name: 뤼튼 (wrtn)
services.what_it_does: General-purpose consumer AI app with work tools including '강의 녹음 노트' (real-time and final summaries plus transcript; selectable source/summary languages), usable for meetings.
services.mechanism: STT + LLM summarization; outputs two documents (summary + transcript).
services.takeaway_for_crata: 개인용 녹음 요약 수준이라 기업 회의 분류나 보안 파이프라인 부품으로는 맞지 않습니다.

verification.note: The '강의 녹음 노트' tool exists, with real-time and final summaries, a full transcript and source/summary language selection. The help page explicitly mentions meeting use.

services.name: 웍스AI (wrks AI)
services.what_it_does: Enterprise multi-LLM workspace for Korean companies, with a '회의록 작성 Pro' feature (2026-05), HWPX export, workflow automation, an on-prem MCP Hub, drive-folder connection to agents and Korean open-weight models.
services.mechanism: MCP Hub (2026-07) connects ERP/SCM/groupware/APIs/DBs without opening inbound firewall ports; folder connection (2026-09) lets agents auto-detect file updates; K-open-weight models run on a Korean government AI datacenter so requests and logs stay in Korea; per-department model controls and spend limits.
services.integration: MCP Hub, 14-tool workflow builder (Gmail, Google Workspace, Notion, M365), BizRouter unified LLM API.
services.pricing_status: Active; usage-based (종량제) model pricing; enterprise SaaS since 2024-12.
services.takeaway_for_crata: MCP Hub(인바운드 방화벽 없이 사내시스템 연결)는 CRATA가 고객사에 들어가 그룹웨어·문서 데이터를 안전하게 끌어와 '회사 패턴'을 뽑는 구조의 좋은 레퍼런스입니다. HWPX 내보내기와 '로그가 국경을 넘지 않는' 국산 모델 옵션은 공공·학교 납품물 설계에 꼭 반영하세요.

verification.note: Release notes confirm '회의록 작성 Pro' (2026-05-27), HWPX export (2026-07), MCP Hub with no inbound firewall opening (2026-07-27), BizRouter (2026-09-01) and the 14-tool workflow automation. Usage-based pricing confirmed (etnews). The 'enterprise SaaS since 2024-12' claim was not verified.

services.name: Alli (알리) / Alli LLM App Market · Alli CoWorker
services.what_it_does: About 100 prebuilt enterprise gen-AI apps (internal-document Q&A, automatic meeting minutes, contract review) plus Alli CoWorker for building agents in natural language; SaaS and on-prem with the same architecture.
services.mechanism: RAG and LLM apps; no-code agent builder; consulting-to-deployment service (Alli Expert).
services.integration: SaaS, on-prem and hybrid; 240 customers (Jun 2026); on-prem references at 7 finance and 4 public organizations.
services.pricing_status: Active; Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth market listing approved 2026-09-30.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 'AI 컨설팅부터 제품 도입까지' 묶어 파는 모델(Alli Expert)과 앱마켓 구조는 CRATA의 AX 컨설팅과 아라 에이전트 사업 구조에 직접 맞는 벤치마크입니다. 'SaaS와 설치형을 같은 구조로' 만드는 전략은 학맞통·공공 납품을 고려한 아라 설계 원칙으로 참고하세요.

verification.note: TSE Growth listing approved 2026-09-30, with trading from 2026-10-04. 240 customers (Jun 2026). ~100 apps including meeting transcription. Alli CoWorker confirmed. The homepage confirms a single codebase for SaaS and on-prem.

services.name: 업스테이지 (Upstage) Solar LLM · Document Parse
services.what_it_does: Solar LLM family (Solar Pro 4 API 2026-08, Solar Open 2 250B open-weight 2026-07, Solar Mini 4 2026-09), Document Parse, Information Extract and Upstage Studio; deployable on-prem.
services.mechanism: Document Parse converts complex documents into machine-readable structure; Information Extract pulls structured fields; agentic LLMs for tool calling.
services.integration: Console REST API, AWS/Azure marketplaces, on-premise behind firewall.
services.pricing_status: Active; no speech/STT or meeting product found.
services.takeaway_for_crata: STT는 없지만, 고객사의 기존 HWP/PDF 보고서·기안·회의록 양식을 파싱해 '문서 스타일·양식 패턴'을 추출하는 Goal B 엔진으로 쓸 수 있습니다. 민감정보 때문에 외부 LLM을 쓸 수 없는 학맞통 현장에서는 국산 온프레미스 LLM 후보가 됩니다.

verification.note: Homepage lists Solar Pro 4, Solar Mini 4, Syn Pro, Document Parse, Information Extract, Studio and on-prem. Solar Open 2 is not shown on the homepage. No STT or meeting product, confirmed.

services.name: 셀비 노트 (Selvy Note)
services.what_it_does: Voice-to-text recording for meetings, investigations and counseling with on-device speech recognition usable without internet, plus LLM summaries into user forms and Q&A search over conversations.
services.mechanism: On-device STT engine embedded in laptops/mobiles; sLLM summarization into custom forms; correction learning.
services.integration: Procurement-ready (GS grade 1, SME tech-market certification 2026-02-26); used by ~250 police sites, MOJ KICS, KIPO special judicial police and local-government child-abuse field investigations; ~70 customers.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 학맞통의 상담과 사례회의처럼 아동·학생 민감정보가 오가는 녹음에는 '네트워크 없이 단말에서 전사'하는 방식이 가장 방어적입니다. 지자체 아동학대 조사에 쓰인 레퍼런스가 있어 교육청 보안 심사를 통과하기 유리하니, 학맞통 솔루션에 넣을 녹음·전사 부품으로 우선 검토하세요.

verification.note: On-device offline STT, GS grade 1, SME tech-market certification (2026-02-26) and ~70 customers (police, local governments, fire, military) confirmed. The specific 'KICS' and 'child-abuse field investigation' references and the ~250 police sites were not verified.

services.name: AI레포토 (AI Repoto)
services.what_it_does: AI meeting minutes with speaker diarization, extraction of decisions, tasks and schedules, company templates and a custom terminology dictionary; integrates with Zoom, Teams, Webex, Meet and RemoteMeeting.
services.mechanism: STT + LLM summarization into fixed company templates; 4-tier permissions plus per-document access; unlimited re-summarization on on-prem.
services.integration: SaaS, on-premise, private cloud; video-conference integrations.
services.pricing_status: Active; ISO 27001/27017; public customers incl. Korea Sports Promotion Foundation and K-water.
services.takeaway_for_crata: '회사 템플릿 + 사전'으로 고객사 양식에 맞춘 회의록을 만드는 방식은 Goal B에서 고객사 문서 스타일을 템플릿 자산으로 바꾸는 방법론과 같은 결입니다. 공공기관용 설치형 회의록 대안으로도 비교 대상입니다.

verification.note: Confirmed: ISO 27001/27017, SaaS plus on-prem, extraction of decisions/tasks/schedules, Zoom/Teams/Webex/Meet/RemoteMeeting integration, K-water and the Sports Promotion Foundation as customers, HWP export and a 나라장터 listing. Speaker ID relies on users registering their voices.

services.name: MoAI 노트
services.what_it_does: AI meeting notes with multi-speaker diarization, multiple summary formats (summary, keywords, Q&A, to-do) and MoAI Bot, which uses RAG to search and compare across meetings.
services.mechanism: Voice-authentication-based diarization (vendor claims 94.62% accuracy); RAG across meeting records.
services.integration: Zoom integration; on-premise for closed networks.
services.pricing_status: Active; free tier; enterprise by inquiry; ISO 27001.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 여러 회의를 가로질러 RAG로 비교·검색하는 봇은 '프로젝트별 회의 누적 지식'을 구현할 때 참고할 만합니다. 폐쇄망 구축형 회의록의 비교 대안이기도 합니다.

verification.note: Furence confirmed. Diarization (claimed 94.62%), multiple summary formats, MoAI Bot RAG across meetings, closed-network on-prem, free tier and ISO 27001 (to 2027-11) confirmed. Integrates with Teams and Webex as well as Zoom.

services.name: 브리티웍스 (Brity Works)
services.what_it_does: AI collaboration suite (AI search, knowledge management, document drafting, messenger, video meetings, mobile reporting/approval, AI meeting-minutes summaries), selected by 9 central ministries in 2026.
services.mechanism: Runs on a PPP cloud with the National Intelligence Service's highest '상' security grade.
services.integration: Government PPP cloud; intelligent work-management platform project.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 공공 협업툴 시장이 네이버웍스, 두레이, 브리티웍스 3강으로 재편되고 있습니다. 교육청·지자체 고객에게 회의 자동 분류 솔루션을 납품하려면 이 3개 플랫폼에 결과를 꽂아 넣는 연동(업무 등록·문서 저장)을 전제로 설계해야 합니다.

verification.note: Nine ministries rolling out through 2026-08, PPP cloud at the NIS top grade, and AI meeting-minutes summaries all confirmed (asiae 2026-08-13). The Ministry of Economy/Budget adopted it separately in 2026-04.

methods.name: 택소노미 우선 계층 분류 + 신뢰도 기반 사람 검토 (Taxonomy-first hierarchical classification with HITL)
methods.description: Define a controlled vocabulary (business line > project > sub-task, with aliases, client names and keywords), then classify each transcript with an LLM using few-shot examples and the taxonomy as allowed labels; low-confidence results go to a human review queue. Callabo's 'AI label auto-recommend/set' is the closest Korean commercial analogue.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: ①CRATA 사업부(강의·워크샵/학맞통/아라 등)와 하위 프로젝트를 YAML/DB로 정의하고, 프로젝트마다 고객사명·담당자·고유 용어를 넣습니다. ②전사 + 캘린더 일정명 + 참석자를 LLM에 넣어 JSON(사업부, 프로젝트, 신뢰도, 근거 발화 타임스탬프)으로 받습니다. ③신뢰도가 임계값보다 낮으면 '확인 필요' 큐로 보내고, 사람이 고친 결과는 few-shot 예시로 다시 넣어 점점 정확도를 높입니다.

methods.name: 회의 토픽 세그멘테이션 → 세그먼트별 분류·라우팅
methods.description: Split a long meeting into topical segments using timestamps and diarized turns (topic-shift detection by LLM or embedding similarity), then classify and route each segment separately. No Korean vendor was found offering this, so it is CRATA's build opportunity.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 화자분리와 타임스탬프가 있는 전사(CLOVA Speech 장문, RTZR use_diarization)를 받아, LLM에게 '주제 전환 지점과 구간별 주제'를 뽑게 합니다. 각 구간을 위의 택소노미 분류기에 따로 넣어, 한 회의에서 학맞통 구간은 학맞통 프로젝트로, 아라 구간은 아라 백로그로 각각 보냅니다. 원문 타임스탬프 링크를 함께 남기면 나중에 근거를 추적할 수 있습니다.

methods.name: MCP 기반 도구 체인 라우팅 (STT/노트 MCP → LLM → 협업툴 MCP)
methods.description: Use MCP servers on both ends: a note source (e.g., Tiro MCP list_notes/get_note_transcript) and a work destination (e.g., flow's official ChatGPT/Claude app with 39 functions, Linear, Notion), with the LLM doing classification and deliverable generation in between.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 단기에는 Claude에 노트 소스 MCP(티로 또는 플라우드 export 폴더)와 flow/Notion MCP를 연결하고, '분류 → 프로젝트별 요약 → 업무 생성 → 산출물 초안(제안서·강의안)' 프롬프트를 스킬로 고정합니다. 이렇게 하면 지금의 복붙을 없앨 수 있습니다. 중기에는 이 흐름을 아라 에이전트의 기본 워크플로로 제품화합니다.

methods.name: 도메인 어휘 사전·키워드 부스팅 (Custom lexicon & keyword boosting)
methods.description: Register company-specific proper nouns and jargon in STT (CLOVA Speech 'boostings', RTZR 'keywords', CLOVA Note '자주 쓰는 단어' up to 1,000 words, Tiro wordbook) to raise accuracy; the same lexicon becomes a feature for classification and a measurable artifact of a company's language.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: Goal A에서는 사업부별 고유어(학맞통, 학생맞춤통합지원위원회, 아라 등)를 부스팅 목록과 분류 힌트로 같이 씁니다. Goal B에서는 고객사 진단 첫 주에 회의 녹음·문서에서 자주 나오는 용어, 약어, 직함, 호칭을 뽑아 '회사 용어집'을 만들고, 이를 STT 부스팅과 업무사이트 UI 문구(메뉴명·버튼명)에 그대로 반영합니다.

methods.name: 회의 기반 조직 지식그래프/위키 (사람·주제·결정 관계 지도)
methods.description: Continuously extract entities (people, topics, decisions) and relations from meeting notes into an editable wiki/graph that adapts to user corrections, as Tiro Wiki does.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: Goal B의 '회사 패턴 추출'에 그대로 응용할 수 있습니다. 고객사 회의 2~4주치를 모아 ①누가 결정하는지(의사결정자·결재 흐름) ②어떤 주제가 반복되는지 ③결정이 어떤 형식으로 기록되는지를 그래프로 만듭니다. 이 그래프가 업무사이트의 조직도, 프로젝트 메뉴, 결정 로그 페이지의 설계 입력이 됩니다.

methods.name: 템플릿·양식·업무구조 추출 기반 회사 스타일 프로파일링
methods.description: Mine a client's existing documents (minutes templates, reports, WBS/planning files) to extract format, tone and structure, using document parsing (Upstage Document Parse), company templates (AI Repoto, CLOVA Note custom summary templates) and project-structure generation from WBS/docs (flow project-design agent).
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 고객사 기존 회의록·보고서·기안·WBS를 수집해 Document Parse로 구조화합니다. 그다음 ①문서 양식(항목 순서·표 구조) ②문체(경어 수준·개조식 여부) ③업무 단위(프로젝트·태스크 분해 방식)를 '스타일 프로파일 JSON'으로 표준화합니다. 이 프로파일로 회의록 템플릿, 업무사이트 페이지 구조, 산출물 생성 프롬프트를 자동으로 만듭니다.

methods.name: 민감정보 프라이버시 바이 디자인 파이프라인 (학맞통용)
methods.description: Layered controls for sensitive student data: on-device or on-prem STT (Selvy Note, Daglo/RTZR on-prem), PII masking/DLP before any LLM call (Dooray's prompt DLP guardrail and 3-layer infrastructure/export/usage control), domestic models or Korean-region processing (wrks AI K-open-weight models), short retention (RTZR deletes results after 3 days), and public-cloud certifications (CSAP/PPP).
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 학맞통 상담·사례회의 녹음은 ①단말/설치형 STT로 전사 ②이름·학번·주소·건강/복지 정보를 가명화 ③가명화된 텍스트만 LLM으로 분류·요약 ④원본 오디오는 정해진 기간 후 자동 삭제하는 4단계로 설계합니다. 교육청에 납품할 때는 CSAP·PPP 플랫폼(네이버웍스·두레이·브리티웍스) 연동이나 설치형을 전제로 제안합니다.

claim_verdicts.claim: NAVER WORKS CLOVA Note business plans are billed per company domain regardless of headcount (Lite ₩20,000/mo with 1,000 min); Team plan and above include external-system API integration, and Business and above add automatic speaker identification and custom AI summary templates.
claim_verdicts.correction: All points match the official pricing page. One update: the frequent-words dictionary on every plan now holds 2,000 entries (1,000 shared + 1,000 personal), not 1,000. Enterprise is for orgs with 500+ employees, by inquiry.

claim_verdicts.claim: RTZR STT API costs ₩1,000/hour for the first 1,000 hours a month (down to ₩300/hour), gives 600 free minutes, supports use_diarization with automatic speaker count and keyword boosting, and deletes results after 3 days.
claim_verdicts.correction: Tiered (progressive) pricing excl. VAT: T1 ₩1,000, T2 ₩500 (to 10,000h), T3 ₩400 (to 25,000h), T4 ₩300; 10-second minimum. diarization.spk_count=0 auto-predicts the speaker count; `keywords` boosting exists. The docs index states results are kept for 3 days and then deleted.

claim_verdicts.claim: CLOVA Speech supports speaker diarization (enable/speakerCountMin/speakerCountMax) only in long-form recognition, not in real-time streaming, and offers keyword boostings and async callback.
claim_verdicts.correction: The troubleshooting guide says diarization works in long-form recognition only and is not possible in streaming. The long-form API (url/object-storage/upload) has callback, boostings, forbiddens, diarization{enable,speakerCountMin,speakerCountMax} and sed (emotion detection). Streaming supports only ko/en/ja.

claim_verdicts.claim: Tiro provides REST API, MCP (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and CLI on every plan, while its 'folder automation' only applies a folder's preset settings to notes created in that folder and does not AI-route notes.
claim_verdicts.correction: The docs say: 'All three are included on every plan at no extra cost.' Folder automation applies preset title, participants, documents and auto-sharing to notes created inside the folder. It does not do AI classification or routing.

claim_verdicts.claim: Callabo (Return Zero) lists an 'AI 레이블 자동 추천/설정' feature, holds ISO 27001, and marks its Webhook API as coming soon.
claim_verdicts.correction: The pricing page lists 'AI 레이블 자동 추천/설정' and 'Webhook API (제공 예정)'. ISO/IEC 27001 is valid 2024-12-26 to 2027-12-25.

claim_verdicts.claim: flow (Madras Check) became an official app in both ChatGPT and Claude via MCP on 2026-06-25, exposing 39 functions including task creation, assignee designation and schedule registration.
claim_verdicts.correction: 2026-06-25 is when flow first unveiled its MCP integration at its 'AX Festa' event. It is not the date of official-app registration. The article reporting registration in both ChatGPT and Claude is dated 2026-09-17 and gives no exact registration date. The 39 functions (search, task creation, assignee, status, comments, schedules) and the 1M+ AI calls in 3 months are confirmed.

claim_verdicts.claim: NHN Dooray holds CSAP standard-grade certification, serves about 150 public institutions, and uses a DLP guardrail to stop sensitive data from entering LLM prompts.
claim_verdicts.correction: All three are confirmed. Dooray also holds the FSI CSP evaluation, CSA STAR Gold, ISMS-P and ISO 27001/27017/27018/27701. It won the PIPC Chair's Award at the 2026 privacy tech awards.

claim_verdicts.claim: Selvas AI's Selvy Note uses on-device speech recognition and is used by police, the MOJ KICS system and local-government child-abuse field investigations.
claim_verdicts.correction: On-device recognition with no internet (Selvy Note 3.0) is confirmed, as is use by police, the MOJ, KIPO and local governments for investigation and counseling records (ddaily 2024-06-27). A 2026-02-26 ddaily article adds ~70 customers, including police, local governments, fire and military, plus GS grade 1. The cited ITWorld article is from 2023-01-30 and only covers the KIPO deployment. I could not verify the specific KICS integration or the child-abuse field-investigation use.

summary_ko:
1) 글로벌 시장은 이미 '패턴 추출 → 회사 컨텍스트 그래프 → AI 에이전트 실행' 구조로 모였습니다. Gartner는 2026년 5월 평가 보고서 이름을 'Process Mining'에서 'Process Intelligence'로 바꿨고, 주요 업체는 각자 그래프를 내세웁니다(Celonis PI Graph+MCP 서버, Skan의 Context Graph of Work(2026.8 시리즈C 6,300만 달러), Soroco Work Graph, Glean Enterprise Graph, MS Work IQ).
2) 회사 패턴을 뽑는 데이터 출처는 네 층입니다. ①ERP 같은 시스템 이벤트 로그(Celonis·Signavio·ARIS·Disco) ②PC·브라우저 사용 기록(태스크 마이닝: UiPath·Skan·Mimica·KYP·Scribe Optimize·Workfellow) ③협업 메타데이터(캘린더·메일·메신저로 보는 조직 네트워크 분석, ONA: Viva Insights·Worklytics·Polinode) ④비정형 텍스트(메일·티켓·회의 전사본: UiPath Communications Mining, LLM으로 텍스트를 이벤트 로그로 바꾸는 연구).
3) 찾아내는 패턴은 업무 흐름의 갈래(variant), 병목·대기 시간, 재작업 반복, 담당자 간 넘김(handoff), 정해진 절차에서 벗어난 부분, 시간 배분과 잦은 작업 전환, 협업 네트워크(중심 인물·고립된 팀·중개자), 회의 부담 등입니다.
4) CRATA 고객인 중소기업·학교는 ①이 거의 없습니다. 그래서 ③과 ④를 중심에 두고, ②는 직원 동의를 받은 가벼운 방식(허용한 사이트만 보는 브라우저 확장, 직원이 직접 녹화하는 보조 방식)으로 더하는 조합이 현실적입니다.
5) GOAL B 제안은 회사 컨텍스트 그래프(가벼운 조직 디지털 트윈)입니다. 사람·팀·프로젝트·문서·회의·결정을 객체로, 그 사이에 일어난 일을 이벤트로 OCEL 2.0 형식에 저장합니다. 그 위에서 업무 포털 구조를 자동으로 만듭니다(메뉴=핵심 업무 흐름, 대시보드=병목 지표, 매뉴얼=SOP, 권한·결재선=ONA로 본 정보 흐름).
6) 바로 쓸 수 있는 진단 도구는 Fluxicon Disco(CSV), Power Automate 90일 체험판, Worklytics 무료 등급(캘린더 데이터, 100명까지), 설문형 ONA를 하는 Polinode입니다. 직접 엔진을 만든다면 pm4py(OCEL 2.0·조직 네트워크 분석·LLM 요약 지원)를 부품으로 쓸 수 있지만, AGPL 라이선스라 상용화 전에 검토가 필요합니다.
7) GOAL A(회의 자동 분류)에는 UiPath Communications Mining의 방식이 그대로 맞습니다. 라벨 없이 주제를 계층으로 자동 묶고(비지도 계층 토픽 발견), 사람이 몇 개만 라벨을 확정하면 그걸로 모델을 다듬습니다(액티브 러닝).
8) 국내 현황입니다. 퍼즐데이터 ProDiscovery는 스스로 '국내 유일 프로세스 마이닝 전문기업'이라 하고, GS인증 1등급을 받아 공공 조달이 가능합니다. LG CNS는 2026년 6월 Celonis와 손잡았는데 대기업 대상입니다. 유엔진 Process-GPT는 대화로 BPMN·양식·조직도를 만들어 줍니다. 중소기업·교육기관용으로 '문서·회의 기반 가벼운 패턴 추출 + 업무 포털 자동 생성'을 하는 곳은 찾지 못했고, 이 빈자리가 CRATA가 차지할 수 있는 위치입니다.
9) 개인정보는 처음부터 설계 원칙으로 넣어야 합니다. Skan·Worklytics·Scribe처럼 개인이 아닌 집계로 보기, 메타데이터만 쓰기, 허용 목록 지정, 사전 동의를 기본으로 합니다. 국내 근로자 감시 논란과 학맞통의 학생 개인정보를 고려하면 필수입니다.

services.name: Celonis (Process Intelligence Graph / AgentC / PI MCP Server)
services.what_it_does: Builds a system-agnostic Process Intelligence Graph (digital twin of operations) from ERP/CRM data, task-mining data, PDFs and emails, enriched with business rules, KPIs and benchmarks, and exposes it to AI agents.
services.mechanism: Object-centric process mining (OCPM): extracts objects (order, invoice…) and their events from source systems into an object-event model, then adds business context; AI-driven Task Discovery for desktop data; the graph is served to agents through a Process Intelligence MCP server and Orchestration Engine.
relevant_features: Object-centric process mining (Performance Spectrum, Instance Explorer)
60+ pre-built objects/events with AI assistants for data modeling
services.integration: MCP server; Data Core zero-copy with Databricks/Microsoft Fabric; Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Copilot Studio
services.korean_support: Korean enterprise channel: LG CNS signed an agentic-AI process intelligence partnership with Celonis on 2026-06-01 (Celonis + LG CNS AgenticWorks).
services.pricing_status: Active; enterprise custom pricing; Leader in 2026 Gartner MQ for Process Intelligence (May 8, 2026).
services.takeaway_for_crata: '객체·이벤트·업무 맥락(규칙·KPI)'을 하나의 그래프로 묶는 PI Graph 구조를 CRATA의 '고객사 컨텍스트 그래프' 데이터 모델로 벤치마킹하세요. ERP가 없어도 학생·사례회의·공문·강의·견적 같은 객체로 OCPM식 모델을 만들 수 있습니다. 이를 MCP 서버로 아라 에이전트에 연결하는 구조도 그대로 가져올 수 있습니다. 제품 자체는 중소기업·학교에는 과합니다.

verification.note: Active. The PI MCP Server and the expansion to task mining, PDFs and emails are confirmed (Nov 4, 2025). Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner MQ for Process Intelligence on May 8, 2026. A Jun 1, 2026 partnership with LG CNS was reported in Korean press.

services.name: SAP Signavio (Joule with SAP Signavio, Joule Agents)
services.what_it_does: Process mining on SAP and non-SAP event logs combined with a process model repository and best-practice reference content; Joule conversational assistant GA Feb 10, 2026; five Joule Agents in beta (workspace admin, screen explainer, process content recommender, dashboard analyzer, business use-case translation).
services.mechanism: Event-log mining + conformance against reference process content; agents reason over best-practice libraries to recommend process content and interpret dashboards/KPIs.
services.pricing_status: Active; enterprise pricing; Leader in 2026 Gartner MQ for Process Intelligence Platforms.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 핵심은 '업종별 모범 프로세스 라이브러리'를 들고 들어가 고객사의 현재 업무와 비교·진단하는 방식입니다. CRATA도 학교·교육청·중소기업용 레퍼런스 업무 템플릿(학맞통 사례관리, 강의 운영 등)을 쌓아 갭 분석 자산으로 만드세요.

verification.note: Joule with SAP Signavio became generally available on Feb 10, 2026, and the article points to a Joule Agents beta program. The list of five agents could not be re-fetched (the PEX page returned 405). Leader in the MQ for Process Intelligence Platforms (May 5, 2026).

services.name: UiPath Process Mining + Task Mining (Process Intelligence)
services.what_it_does: Mines event logs from SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow and others, and captures desktop work that system logs miss; insights feed UiPath Maestro agentic orchestration.
services.mechanism: Unassisted Task Mining: a lightweight recorder captures a screenshot plus metadata on every click/keystroke, applies PII masking, then an ML model segments discrete steps and finds repeatable tasks. Assisted Task Mining lets employees record variations of a known task.
services.integration: UiPath Automation Cloud / AI Center; connectors to major ERPs/CRMs
services.takeaway_for_crata: '클릭마다 스크린샷과 로그를 남기고 AI가 반복 업무를 찾아내는' 비보조 방식은 구조만 참고하세요. 국내 근로자 감시 이슈를 감안하면 CRATA는 직원이 대표 업무를 직접 녹화하고 설명하는 '보조(Assisted)' 방식으로 가볍게 가는 편이 현실적입니다.

verification.note: Confirmed: native extraction for SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow and Workday, plus task mining, simulation and Maestro. The cited task-mining page defines only Unassisted mode; the Assisted mode and PII masking were not confirmed on that page.

services.name: UiPath Communications Mining (now part of UiPath IXP; formerly Re:infer)
services.category: Communications mining / unstructured text intent discovery
services.what_it_does: Turns emails, tickets, chats, call transcripts and survey responses into structured labels (taxonomy of topics/intents), entities and fields with confidence scores for routing, insight and automation.
services.mechanism: Tree-structured neural topic models with Transformer embeddings discover a hierarchical topic/intent taxonomy without training data; users then refine labels through active learning (employee-led supervised learning).
services.integration: UiPath IXP API; UiPath automation platform
services.pricing_status: Active; Communications Mining migrated into UiPath IXP (2025).
services.takeaway_for_crata: GOAL A(회의 자동 분류)에 가장 직접 쓸 수 있는 방법론입니다. 플라우드 전사본이나 고객사 메일·메신저를 계층적 주제로 자동으로 묶고, 사람이 '사업부>프로젝트>세부업무' 라벨 몇 개만 확정하면(액티브 러닝) 이후는 자동으로 분류됩니다. GOAL B에서는 고객사 업무 분류체계를 데이터에서 '발견'하는 도구로 쓰면 됩니다.

verification.note: Docs confirm it is a capability of UiPath IXP. It handles emails, tickets, notes, transcripts and surveys, and offers unsupervised hierarchical intent discovery and active learning.

services.name: Microsoft Power Automate Process Mining (Minit) & Task Mining
services.what_it_does: Process maps and metrics from event logs of systems of record (via dataflows), an advanced Windows desktop app (from the Minit acquisition), and task mining from recorded desktop actions via Power Automate for desktop.
services.mechanism: Classic event-log discovery (case/activity/timestamp) plus recorder-based task mining; reports customizable in Power BI.
relevant_features: 90-day trial: task mining + process mining (100 MB per process)
Premium per-user license adds 50 MB to a tenant pool (up to 100 GB)
services.integration: Dataverse, Power BI, Power Platform connectors, SAP templates
services.korean_support: Microsoft Learn docs available in Korean; M365 widely used in Korea
services.pricing_status: Active (docs updated Aug–Sep 2026); bundled with Power Automate Premium; add-on for capacity.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사가 M365 환경이면 90일 체험판으로 바로 시험해 볼 수 있습니다. CRATA가 만든 CSV 이벤트 로그(공문·결재·상담 기록 등)를 넣어 업무 흐름도를 즉석에서 보여주는 '진단 데모'용으로 쓰세요.

verification.note: Licensing details confirmed (doc dated Aug 28, 2026). The Minit-based preview was announced Nov 15, 2022.

services.name: Apromore
services.what_it_does: Process mining, simulation, root-cause analysis and compliance; native task mining via Digital Agents capturing screen- and field-level interactions; now feeding Salesforce Agentforce.
services.mechanism: Event-log discovery plus simulation-based what-if analysis and conformance checking; task-mining agents capture workstation interactions at configurable intervals.
services.takeaway_for_crata: what-if 시뮬레이션과 적합성 검사를 컨설팅 산출물로 쓰는 방식을 참고하세요. 이제 독립 업체가 아니라 Salesforce 생태계에 들어갔으므로 소규모 고객에 단독 도입하는 것은 권하지 않습니다.

verification.note: Salesforce signed on Oct 9, 2025 and closed on Nov 3, 2025. The site says 'now part of Salesforce'. Task Mining, simulation, Compliance Center and Copilot are still listed.

services.name: Fluxicon Disco
services.what_it_does: Creates process maps from any event log in minutes, with animation, variant explorer, filters and statistics.
services.mechanism: Needs only Case ID, Activity and Timestamp (optional resource/attributes); imports CSV, Excel, XES, MXML; discovers a frequency/performance-annotated process map and groups cases into variants.
services.pricing_status: Active; commercial pricing on request; academic licenses available.
services.takeaway_for_crata: ERP가 없는 고객사도 엑셀로 만든 '업무 이벤트 표'만 있으면 몇 분 안에 업무 흐름의 갈래와 병목을 지도로 그릴 수 있습니다. CRATA 컨설턴트용 진단 도구로 바로 쓸 만합니다.

verification.note: Active. Supports CSV/Excel, XES and MXML import, a variants explorer and animation. Pricing is not shown, and academic licensing is not mentioned on the product page.

services.name: ARIS (Process Mining + modeling)
services.company: SAG ARIS GmbH (Silver Lake-owned, spun out of Software AG)
services.what_it_does: Enterprise process repository (organization, roles, systems, documents) combined with process mining; April 2026 release added object-centric process mining; AI Companion for model generation and chat.
services.mechanism: Metamodel-driven modeling (org–role–process–system–document) plus event-log mining and conformance (Process Quick Checks compare processes and show deviations and their KPI impact).
relevant_features: Free 'Process Mining Basic' CSV-upload edition (older info; verify)
services.pricing_status: Active; standalone since Jan 2025; Leader in 2026 Gartner MQ for Process Intelligence.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사 업무 포털의 정보구조를 짤 때 ARIS식 메타모델(조직-역할-업무-시스템-문서 연결)을 빌려 쓰세요. 모델링과 마이닝을 결합한 이 전통 BPM 방식이 업무 사이트 설계의 뼈대가 됩니다.

verification.note: Active. Object-centric process mining shipped in the April 2026 release. Leader in the inaugural MQ for Process Intelligence Platforms, and also in the Jul 27, 2026 MQ for Digital Twin of an Organization Platforms. Since Jan 7, 2025 it has been run as an independent company under Silver Lake's Software GmbH; the 2026 rebrand came with new CEO Guillaume Bacuvier. The softwareag.com 'ARIS Process Mining Basic' page now returns 404, so the free CSV edition is unverified and probably gone.

services.name: Skan AI (Context Graph of Work)
services.category: Computer-vision task mining / work context graph for agents
services.what_it_does: Observes desktop work across apps (spreadsheets, CRMs, email, legacy systems) with computer vision, extracts intent and abstracts it into a process model and 'Context Graph of Work'; products Skan AI Intelligence, Blueprint and Agents.
services.mechanism: Computer-vision observation → intent extraction → aggregated process model/context graph; privacy architecture aggregates across workers, opt-in app/URL scope, only anonymized metadata to cloud, context models kept on-prem.
services.pricing_status: Active; $63M Series C announced Aug 12, 2026 (Cathay Innovation, Dell Technologies Capital); Honorable Mention in 2026 Gartner MQ.
services.takeaway_for_crata: '관찰 → 의도 추출 → 업무 맥락 그래프 → 에이전트 설계도'로 이어지는 흐름이 GOAL B와 거의 같습니다. 특히 개인을 추적하지 않고 집계하는 방식, 앱 허용 목록, 익명화 구조는 국내 고객사(노조·개인정보 담당)를 설득하는 논리로 그대로 쓸 만합니다.

verification.note: $63M Series C in Aug 2026 confirmed. Products: Blueprint, Process Intelligence, Engineering Intelligence and Agents. Honorable Mention in the 2026 MQ for Process Intelligence Platforms.

services.name: KYP.ai (Productivity 360)
services.what_it_does: Continuously captures desktop activity across people, processes and technology, quantifies inefficiencies and automation ROI, and generates agent code with business context; includes automated time tracking and WFO/WFH productivity comparisons.
services.mechanism: Continuous activity capture → time allocation, workload balance and digital-friction analytics → ROI calculation per opportunity → 'Agentic AI Enabler' outputs.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 업무 시간 배분, 도구별 사용 시간, 업무 마찰을 'ROI(절감 시간 × 인건비)'로 환산하는 보고서 형식을 CRATA AX 진단 보고서 템플릿으로 참고하세요.

verification.note: The domain is live but sits behind a Sucuri JavaScript challenge, so neither the feature claims nor the HQ could be verified from primary pages.

services.name: Mimica (Miner / Mapper / Analyst / Maker)
services.what_it_does: Records clicks and keystrokes, automatically builds hierarchical process maps (steps → tasks → processes), extracts case IDs, and recommends what to eliminate, standardize or automate; Analyst is a conversational agent and Maker an automation builder.
services.mechanism: Observational capture with no manual tagging → ML segmentation into steps/tasks/processes → prioritized recommendations.
relevant_features: Case ID extraction from desktop activity
services.pricing_status: Active; Series B; representative vendor in the 2026 Gartner Market Guide for Task Mining (May 2026).
services.takeaway_for_crata: '단계→작업→프로세스' 3단계 업무 지도와 '없애기·표준화·자동화' 3분류 추천은 CRATA가 고객사 업무를 정리할 때 그대로 쓸 수 있는 틀입니다.

verification.note: Representative vendor in the 2026 Gartner Market Guide for Task Mining Tools (post dated May 21, 2026). Gartner highlighted its case ID extraction and its hierarchical steps, tasks and processes.

services.name: Soroco Scout (Work Graph)
services.what_it_does: A multimodal model learns from digital interaction data to build a Work Graph of how teams and agents use software, documents and tasks, exposing hidden effort, context switching, handoffs and escalations.
services.mechanism: Interaction telemetry → TribeScope foundation model → Work Graph exposed via APIs for third-party apps; anonymized, opt-in.
services.integration: APIs/abstractions over the Work Graph; Microsoft Marketplace listing
services.pricing_status: Active; Everest Group PEAK Matrix Leader (5th consecutive year, per vendor).
services.takeaway_for_crata: 작업 전환·핸드오프·에스컬레이션을 핵심 지표로 삼는 점, 그리고 워크그래프를 API로 열어 다른 앱이 그 위에 올라가게 한 구조를 참고하세요. CRATA 업무 포털도 '고객사 워크그래프 위에 얹는 앱'으로 설계하면 됩니다.

verification.note: Active, and a Leader in Everest's DII PEAK Matrix 2026 for the fifth year. The '48 hours' figure comes only from the SoftwareOne listing; Soroco's homepage says a full operational picture takes 2–4 weeks. Built on its TribeScope model. APIs work with Power BI, Qlik, Python and Rust.

services.name: Scribe (Scribe Capture + Scribe Optimize)
services.what_it_does: Optimize (announced Nov 12, 2025) mines workflows in admin-approved browser apps for consenting users, showing time spent, bottlenecks and duplicated workflows with ROI business cases; 'Discover workflows' auto-turns detected workflows into step-by-step guides.
services.mechanism: Browser extension capturing actions only on allow-listed domains → workflow detection → time and bottleneck analytics → AI recommendations; desktop and mainframe apps not supported.
services.pricing_status: Active; Optimize not yet available to all users at announcement.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사 직원이 웹에서 반복하는 업무를 단계별 가이드(SOP)로 자동 문서화하면, 그게 곧 업무 포털의 '업무 매뉴얼' 콘텐츠가 됩니다. 허용 도메인 지정과 동의 기반 수집은 국내에 적용할 때 꼭 지켜야 할 설계 원칙입니다.

verification.note: Optimize was announced on Nov 12, 2025. It works only in the browser, captures only consenting users in admin-approved apps, and was not generally available at announcement. The 'Discover workflows' help article returned 403 and was not verified.

services.name: Workfellow (now ProcessMaker)
services.category: Hybrid process + task mining via browser
services.what_it_does: Creates unified event logs from multiple apps through a 'Work API' browser plugin, combining process mining and task mining without system integration.
services.mechanism: Browser extensions (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari) emit cross-application events → unified event log → automated process discovery.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 시스템 연동 없이 브라우저 확장만으로 이벤트 로그를 만드는 가벼운 혼합 방식은 ERP 없는 중소기업·학교에 가장 현실적인 모델입니다. CRATA가 자체 수집기를 만든다면 참고할 설계입니다.

verification.note: ProcessMaker acquired it on Apr 9, 2024. ProcessMaker has since merged with Decisions: processmaker.com now redirects to decisions.com, and press calls them 'Decisions + ProcessMaker'. workfellow.ai is still live with a 'now part of ProcessMaker' banner, but the browser-plugin and UiPath Marketplace claims are not on the current page. ARIS now ships 'ARIS Task Mining by ProcessMaker'.

services.name: Microsoft Viva Insights (ONA) + Work IQ
services.category: Collaboration analytics / organizational network analysis / work intelligence layer
services.what_it_does: Viva Insights runs ONA on Microsoft 365 collaboration signals (cross-group collaboration, insular/siloed groups, 'central hub' teams, change-management template) plus Copilot analytics; Work IQ (Ignite, Nov 2025) is the layer that lets Copilot and agents know how you work, with whom, and on what content.
services.mechanism: Metadata from email, meetings, chats and files → network metrics and collaboration patterns; Work IQ combines data + memory (habits, writing tone, go-to collaborators) + inference (linking chat mentions to folders/people).
relevant_features: Work IQ memory of work patterns
services.pricing_status: Active; requires Viva Insights / M365 Copilot licensing.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사가 M365를 쓰면 협업 메타데이터가 이미 쌓여 있습니다. 고립된 팀과 중심 인물을 분석하면 '이 회사는 누구를 거쳐 결정하는가'가 보입니다. Work IQ의 '데이터-기억-추론' 3층 구조는 아라 에이전트가 고객사를 이해하는 층을 설계할 때 그대로 참고할 만합니다.

verification.note: ONA covers cross-group collaboration, insularity and silos, central hubs, and offers a Change management template (doc dated Sep 15, 2026). The Work IQ description matches Microsoft's Ignite 2025 blog word for word.

services.name: Worklytics
services.what_it_does: Turns metadata from 25–50+ tools (M365, Google Workspace, Slack, Teams, Zoom, Jira, GitHub, ChatGPT, Copilot) into collaboration maps, network metrics, meeting/focus insights and AI-adoption tracking, without storing content.
services.mechanism: Metadata-only passive ONA (who meets, messages or emails whom) → centrality, density, collaboration volume, meeting effectiveness, manager effectiveness.
relevant_features: Free tier: calendar-only, up to 100 users, 30-day history
services.korean_support: Not verified; works with Google Workspace/M365 used in Korea
services.pricing_status: Active; Free $0; Business from $2,500/month (up to 200 users); Enterprise custom.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 무료 등급(캘린더만, 100명까지)으로 고객사의 회의 부담·집중 시간·협업 패턴을 바로 진단할 수 있어 AX 컨설팅 '사전 진단' 패키지에 쓰기 좋습니다. 내용은 보지 않고 메타데이터만 쓰는 원칙도 그대로 가져오세요.

verification.note: Pricing confirmed. Its blog says 'more than 25 tools', including ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini, Jira and GitHub. Data is anonymized or pseudonymized at the source.

services.name: Polinode
services.what_it_does: Maps collaboration, influence and information flow using relationship surveys (active ONA) and/or metadata from Office 365, Google Workspace, Teams and Slack (passive ONA); 30+ metrics, AI Networks Chat, up to 50k nodes / 250k edges.
services.mechanism: Survey-based relationship graphs and/or metadata graphs → centrality, betweenness, brokerage, community detection → agentic AI Q&A over the network.
services.pricing_status: Active; 'start free' / demo, pricing not public.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 협업 기록이 없거나 개인정보에 민감한 학교·교육기관에서는 설문형(Active) ONA가 대안입니다. '업무상 누구에게 묻고 누구와 일하나'를 설문으로 받아 실제 의사결정·정보 흐름 지도를 그리고, 포털 권한과 결재선 설계에 반영하세요. 컨설턴트용 상품이라 CRATA가 직접 쓸 수 있습니다.

verification.note: Active. Offers active and passive ONA, 30+ metrics, AI networks chat, up to 50k nodes and 250k edges, and a free start. The company is Polinode Pty Ltd, which points to Australia.

services.name: Glean Enterprise Graph
services.category: Enterprise knowledge/work graph for AI agents
services.what_it_does: Launched Sept 25, 2025: a company-wide knowledge graph plus personal graphs mapping people, teams, projects, products and processes from 100+ data sources, used by agents for multi-hop reasoning.
services.mechanism: Activity signals (views, edits, comments, replies) + content + metadata → ML infers the broader tasks and projects behind individual app actions → process knowledge for agents.
services.integration: Connectors to SaaS apps; agent platform
services.takeaway_for_crata: '앱에서의 행동을 보고 상위 업무·프로젝트를 추론하는' 방식은 GOAL A(회의를 프로젝트에 자동 연결)와 GOAL B(회사 업무 구조 추출)의 핵심입니다. CRATA는 문서·회의·메신저 활동을 '사람-팀-프로젝트-문서' 그래프로 엮는 가벼운 버전을 만들어 업무 포털의 백엔드로 쓰면 됩니다.

verification.note: Launched Sep 25, 2025. It maps people, projects, teams and processes, adds personal graphs, and supports multi-hop reasoning. The product page lists 275+ connectors, so '100+' is an undercount.

services.name: ProcessMind
services.category: SMB self-service process mining + modeling + simulation
services.what_it_does: Lets small and mid-sized teams upload Excel or system exports, visualize workflows and simulate improvements; launched Nov 2025.
services.mechanism: Upload-based event-log discovery with a layout engine ('Clarity Engine') + process modeling + simulation.
services.pricing_status: Active; Essential $99, Standard $139, Premium $199 per user/month (per press coverage).
services.takeaway_for_crata: 중소기업용 저가 셀프서비스 프로세스 마이닝 가격대(1인당 월 10~20만 원대)를 참고하세요. 진단 후 고객사가 스스로 운영할 도구로 추천할 수 있습니다.

verification.note: The core features (upload, process mining, simulation, free trial) are correct, and the company is in Deventer, Netherlands. The pricing is outdated: the official page lists Process Foundation at €29, Process Architecture at €99 and Process Intelligence at €299 per seat per month (annual billing, ex VAT), not Essential $99 / Standard $139 / Premium $199. Process mining and simulation are only in the €299 tier. It now also has BPMN modeling and MCP integration.

services.name: 퍼즐데이터 ProDiscovery
services.what_it_does: Reconstructs actual workflows from internal system logs into a digital process twin; generative-AI chatbot PiDi answers process questions conversationally; what-if simulation for staffing or workflow changes.
services.mechanism: Event-log-based discovery, bottleneck and performance analysis + LLM chatbot over results + simulation.
relevant_features: GS certification Grade 1 (eligible for public procurement)
services.integration: Connects to enterprise system logs (past partnership with Douzone ERP)
services.pricing_status: Active (AI EXPO KOREA 2026 exhibitor); 110+ projects; listed 8 consecutive years in Gartner Market Guide for Process Mining (per company); pricing not public.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 공공·교육청 고객(학맞통 등)에 본격적인 프로세스 마이닝이 필요할 때 조달 등록된 국산 파트너로 협업할 수 있습니다. 퍼즐데이터 아카데미로 CRATA 내부 역량을 키우는 것도 가능합니다. 다만 시스템 로그가 전제라 문서·회의 기반 경량 진단은 CRATA가 따로 맡아야 합니다.

verification.note: Confirmed: GS Grade 1, procurement eligibility, PiDi and what-if simulation (Apr 30, 2026). The company site says 110+ projects and 8 consecutive years in the Gartner Market Guide.

services.name: 유엔진 Process-GPT (uEngine6 BPM)
services.category: LLM-based BPM: process/form/org-chart generation + multi-agent execution
services.what_it_does: Defines business processes in natural language ('consulting AI chat') and auto-generates BPMN, stage forms and organization charts; runs them on a multi-agent process execution engine.
services.mechanism: LLM conversation (and image upload per vendor) → BPMN/process definition + forms + org structure → execution; learns from user feedback and system logs to optimize.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 인터뷰·회의 내용을 대화로 넣으면 BPMN·양식·조직도가 자동으로 나오는 국산 사례입니다. CRATA의 '업무 포털 자동 생성기(업무 흐름 → 화면·양식)'를 만들 때 직접 벤치마크할 대상이자 협업 후보입니다.

verification.note: Active commercial product (brochure dated 2026.09). Confirmed: natural-language process definition, BPMN and form generation, org chart by chat, multi-agent execution and a feedback loop. References: KEPCO, SK telecom.

services.name: PM4Py (open-source process mining library)
services.company: PIS – Process Intelligence Solutions (Fraunhofer FIT spin-off)
services.what_it_does: Python library for process discovery, conformance, OCEL 2.0 object-centric mining, social network/organizational mining, and LLM-ready textual abstractions of logs and models.
services.mechanism: pm4py.discover_* on event logs; organizational mining builds handover-of-work and working-together networks from resource fields; pm4py.llm abstracts DFGs, variants and features into text for an LLM.
services.pricing_status: Active; AGPL-3.0 open source with commercial license available.
services.takeaway_for_crata: CRATA가 자체 경량 마이닝 엔진(회의·문서 이벤트를 흐름도와 협업 네트워크로 바꾸고 LLM 요약까지)을 만들 때 핵심 부품입니다. 단 AGPL이라 SaaS로 상용화하면 소스 공개 의무가 생기거나 상용 라이선스가 필요하니 법무 검토가 필요합니다.

verification.note: AGPL-3.0, with a commercial license from PIS (a Fraunhofer FIT spin-off). The ocel and llm extras exist (pip install pm4py[ocel,llm]). Social network mining was not checked on the GitHub README.

methods.name: Minimal event-log construction from non-ERP sources ('eventization')
methods.description: Process mining needs only Case ID, Activity, Timestamp (+ Resource). Even without ERP, these can be derived from file metadata (created/modified/shared), calendar events, approval or official-document records, chat or email headers, and meeting transcripts, then loaded into Disco, Power Automate, ProcessMind or pm4py to find variants, bottlenecks, rework loops and handoffs.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 고객사 진단 첫 2주 동안 공유드라이브 파일 이력, 캘린더, 결재·공문 대장, 메신저 내보내기, 플라우드 회의록을 모아 '건번호-활동-시각-담당자' 4열짜리 CSV로 바꿉니다. 이걸 Disco나 pm4py에 넣어 실제 업무 흐름도, 갈래, 병목, 재작업을 시각화하고 '이 회사의 실제 업무 방식' 보고서의 근거로 씁니다.

methods.name: Object-centric event modeling (OCEL 2.0)
methods.description: Instead of forcing one case notion, events link to multiple objects (e.g., order, item, invoice) with qualified object-to-object relations; standardized as OCEL 2.0 (SQLite/XML/JSON) and adopted by Celonis, ARIS (2026) and pm4py.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 학교·학맞통처럼 하나의 사건(사례회의)에 학생·교사·상담사·외부기관·공문이 함께 얽히는 업무는 객체 중심으로 모델링해야 합니다. CRATA 표준 객체 사전을 정의하세요(학생, 사례, 회의, 문서, 강의, 견적, 계약, 프로젝트 등). 모든 고객사 데이터를 OCEL 2.0 형식으로 저장하면 회사 컨텍스트 그래프의 공통 스키마가 됩니다.

methods.name: LLM text-to-event-log extraction
methods.description: LLMs act as 'data translators' that convert unstructured text (tickets, manuals, reports, emails, transcripts) into structured event logs; recent research finds fine-tuned models significantly outperform zero/few-shot prompting, and related work extracts object-centric logs from text.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 플라우드 회의록, 업무일지, 메일을 LLM으로 '누가-언제-무엇을-어떤 객체에 대해 했다/하기로 했다'는 이벤트로 바꿉니다. 정확도를 위해 CRATA 회의 100~200건을 직접 라벨링한 학습 세트를 만들고, 그걸로 미세조정하거나 few-shot 예시와 검증 규칙을 붙입니다.

methods.name: LLM text-to-process-model generation with human validation
methods.description: Generate BPMN/process models from textual descriptions or interviews with LLMs (ProMoAI from Fraunhofer FIT/RWTH; uEngine Process-GPT; SAP Signavio Joule), then iterate with user feedback.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 인터뷰·회의 전사본으로 'as-is 업무 흐름 초안(BPMN)'을 자동 생성한 뒤 현업 담당자가 검토하는 워크숍을 엽니다. 확정된 흐름은 업무 포털의 메뉴·양식·결재 단계로 그대로 바꿉니다.

methods.name: Hierarchical unsupervised topic/intent discovery + active learning (communications mining)
methods.description: Tree-structured neural topic models over Transformer embeddings discover a topic hierarchy from raw messages without labels; humans then confirm or rename a few clusters and active learning trains a classifier (UiPath Communications Mining/IXP).
methods.how_to_apply_ko: GOAL A 해법입니다. 플라우드 전사본을 문단·발화 단위로 쪼개 임베딩하고 계층적으로 군집하면 사업부 > 프로젝트 > 세부업무 후보가 자동으로 나옵니다. 사람이 몇 개 군집에만 이름을 붙이고, 불확실한 조각을 우선 묻는 액티브 러닝으로 분류기를 고도화합니다. 고객사 메일·메신저에 같은 방식을 쓰면 그 회사의 업무 분류체계를 데이터에서 '발견'할 수 있습니다.

methods.name: Organizational network analysis (passive metadata + active survey) and handover-of-work networks
methods.description: Passive ONA reads who-meets/messages/emails-whom metadata (never content) to compute centrality, betweenness, density, silos and hubs; active ONA uses relationship surveys; process-mining logs yield handover-of-work and working-together networks.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: M365나 Google을 쓰는 고객사는 캘린더 메타데이터로 회의 부담과 협업망을 분석합니다(Worklytics 무료 등급 등). 학교처럼 로그가 없거나 민감한 곳은 5문항 관계 설문(Polinode식)을 씁니다. 결과로 실제 결정권자·정보 허브·고립된 팀을 찾아 포털의 권한, 알림 경로, 결재선 설계에 반영합니다.

methods.name: Lightweight, consent-based task mining (browser allow-list + assisted recording → SOP)
methods.description: Instead of full desktop surveillance, capture only allow-listed web apps for designated consenting users (Scribe Optimize, Workfellow), or have employees record representative tasks (UiPath Assisted Task Mining, Power Automate recorder), auto-producing step-by-step guides and time/bottleneck data.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 고객사 핵심 웹 업무(나이스·에듀파인·그룹웨어 등) 3~5개를 정해 동의한 직원만 녹화하게 합니다. 자동으로 나온 SOP는 포털 '업무 매뉴얼'로, 단계별 소요 시간은 자동화 우선순위(ROI) 근거로 씁니다.

methods.name: Context / work graph as a lightweight Digital Twin of an Organization (DTO-lite)
methods.description: Gartner defines a DTO as a dynamic software model of how an organization operationalizes its business model; vendors implement it as graphs (Celonis PI Graph, Skan Context Graph of Work, Soroco Work Graph, Glean Enterprise Graph, Microsoft Work IQ) linking people, teams, projects, documents, processes and KPIs, and serve it to agents (e.g., via MCP).
methods.how_to_apply_ko: GOAL B의 중심 산출물로 '고객사 컨텍스트 그래프'를 정의하세요. 노드는 사람·팀·프로젝트·문서·회의·결정·용어·양식, 엣지는 핸드오프·언급·승인·참조, 속성은 KPI·주기·톤입니다. 이 그래프에서 업무 포털이 자동으로 만들어지게 합니다(메뉴=상위 업무 흐름, 대시보드=병목 KPI, 용어집=회사 고유 용어, 매뉴얼=SOP, 권한=ONA). 그래프를 MCP 서버로 아라 에이전트에 연결하는 구조로 설계합니다.

methods.name: Textual abstraction of mining results for LLM narrative reports (pm4py.llm)
methods.description: Convert DFGs, top variants, attributes and case features into compact text an LLM can read, so the LLM explains patterns, anomalies and improvement ideas in natural language.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 마이닝 결과(주요 갈래 상위 10개, 직접 이어지는 활동 쌍, 병목 구간)를 텍스트로 요약해 LLM에 넣으면 '이 회사의 업무 패턴 리포트'와 개선안 초안이 자동으로 나옵니다. 이것이 AX 컨설팅의 정형 산출물이 됩니다.

methods.name: Reference-process gap analysis (best-practice library vs as-is)
methods.description: Compare discovered as-is processes against curated best-practice/reference process content and show deviations and KPI impact (SAP Signavio Process Content Recommender, ARIS Process Quick Checks, conformance checking).
methods.how_to_apply_ko: CRATA가 학맞통 사례관리, 교원연수 운영, 중소기업 영업·견적·정산 같은 레퍼런스 업무 템플릿을 쌓아 두고, 고객사의 현재 흐름과 자동으로 비교한 '차이 리포트'를 진단 상품으로 만듭니다.

methods.name: Privacy-by-design for work observation
methods.description: Leading vendors aggregate across workers rather than tracking individuals, restrict capture to opt-in apps/URLs, mask PII, send only anonymized metadata to the cloud, and avoid storing message content (Skan, Worklytics, Scribe, UiPath PII masking, Soroco opt-in).
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 고객사 진단 계약서와 시스템에 처음부터 넣으세요. 개인이 아닌 팀 단위 집계, 내용이 아닌 메타데이터 우선, 수집 대상 앱 허용 목록, 사전 동의, 학생 개인정보 비식별화를 원칙으로 합니다. 국내 근로자 감시 논란과 학맞통 학생 정보 보호를 생각하면 영업상 차별점이 됩니다.

claim_verdicts.claim: Gartner renamed its Magic Quadrant from 'Process Mining Platforms' to 'Process Intelligence' in 2026 (published around May 8, 2026); Celonis, SAP Signavio, ARIS and Pega are among the Leaders.
claim_verdicts.correction: All four are Leaders. Each vendor confirms it in its own release: SAP on May 5, Celonis on May 8, Pega on May 12 and ARIS in its newsroom. The full title is 'Magic Quadrant for Process Intelligence Platforms'. SAP calls it an 'expanded category definition' that adds task mining, modeling and repositories. ARIS calls it the 'inaugural' MQ, so 'renamed' simplifies things. It was published by May 5, a few days before May 8. Note that the cited ARIS URL (aris.com/resources/analyst-report-2026-gartner-magic-quadrant-for-process-intelligence/) now shows a different report: the separate Gartner MQ for Digital Twin of an Organization Platforms (Jul 27, 2026), where ARIS is also a Leader.

claim_verdicts.claim: At Celosphere on Nov 4, 2025, Celonis announced a Process Intelligence MCP Server and expanded its Process Intelligence Graph to include task-mining data, unstructured PDFs and semi-structured emails.

Skan AI raised a $63M Series C (announced Aug 12, 2026, co-led by Cathay Innovation and Dell Technologies Capital) to scale its 'Context Graph of Work', built from computer-vision observation with aggregated, opt-in, anonymized-metadata privacy design.
claim_verdicts.correction: Skan's own page also lists Citi Ventures, Wipro, Bloomberg and State Farm as investors. Its products are Blueprint, Process Intelligence, Engineering Intelligence and Agents.

claim_verdicts.claim: Salesforce completed its acquisition of Apromore on November 3, 2025.
claim_verdicts.correction: The agreement was signed on Oct 9, 2025 and completed on Nov 3, 2025, per an editor's note. apromore.com now says 'Apromore is now part of Salesforce!'

claim_verdicts.claim: UiPath Communications Mining (formerly Re:infer) is now part of UiPath IXP and discovers hierarchical topic/intent taxonomies from emails, tickets, chats, call transcripts without training data, refined with active learning.
claim_verdicts.correction: The docs confirm it is 'a capability in the UiPath IXP service' that handles emails, tickets, notes, transcripts and survey responses. They also describe unsupervised hierarchical topic/intent discovery and active learning. The cited page demonstrates this on the 20 Newsgroups dataset and does not mention Re:infer, though the lineage from UiPath's 2022 Re:infer acquisition is well known.

claim_verdicts.claim: Worklytics offers a $0 free tier (calendar-only, up to 100 users, 30-day history); the Business tier starts at $2,500/month.
claim_verdicts.correction: Business includes up to 200 users, then $10 per user per month, and up to 5 integrations. Enterprise pricing is custom.

claim_verdicts.claim: Power Automate's 90-day trial includes both task mining and process mining (100 MB per process); Premium licenses add 50 MB each to a tenant pool.
claim_verdicts.correction: The pool caps at 100 GB. The Process Mining add-on adds another 100 GB, 2 GB of Dataverse database and 1 TB of Dataverse file capacity. The doc was updated on Aug 28, 2026.

claim_verdicts.claim: 퍼즐데이터 ProDiscovery holds GS certification Grade 1 (eligible for public procurement) and offers the PiDi GenAI chatbot and what-if simulation (article dated Apr 30, 2026); separately, LG CNS signed an agentic-AI process intelligence partnership with Celonis on Jun 1, 2026.
claim_verdicts.correction: The aitimes article (Apr 30, 2026) confirms only the PuzzleData facts: GS Grade 1, eligibility for 조달청 third-party unit-price contracts and 나라장터 listing, the PiDi chatbot, and what-if simulation. It does not mention LG CNS or Celonis. The LG CNS–Celonis partnership comes from a separate nate.com article dated Jun 1, 2026, which describes jointly developing enterprise AI process intelligence solutions.

summary_ko:
핵심: 2025~2026년 'company brain' 시장은 4개 층으로 정리됨. (1) 커넥터/권한(데이터를 어디서 가져오고 누가 볼 수 있나), (2) 그래프(명사 = 사람·프로젝트·고객·문서와 그 관계: Palantir Ontology, Glean Enterprise Graph, Atlassian Teamwork Graph, MS Graph), (3) 행동 패턴(동사 = 일이 실제로 흘러가는 방식: Palantir Action types, Glean의 context graph/trace), (4) Skills/Playbook(회사별 작업 방식과 스타일을 담은 재사용 지시서 패키지).
가장 중요한 흐름: Anthropic이 2025.10 공개한 Agent Skills(SKILL.md 폴더)가 사실상 공통 표준이 됨. Glean Skills(2026.5, 오픈 Agent Skills 표준 import), Dust Skills, Writer Playbooks/Skills, Gemini Enterprise custom skills, MS Work IQ tools&skills가 모두 같은 방향임. 그래서 CRATA가 고객사의 '스타일과 패턴'을 뽑아 Skills 파일로 만들어 두면 어느 플랫폼으로든 옮겨 쓸 수 있음.
'스타일·패턴 추출' 방법론은 Glean의 context graph 정의를 그대로 빌리는 게 가장 실용적임. "why는 못 잡아도 how는 잡을 수 있다"는 관점으로, 문서·회의·승인 기록의 시간순 흔적(trace)에서 반복 패턴을 뽑는 방식임. 여기에 Palantir의 '명사(객체·관계)/동사(액션)' 틀로 고객사 온톨로지를 1장짜리 YAML로 정리하면 됨.
진입 방식(GTM)은 Palantir의 5일 부트캠프 + FDE(현장 파견 엔지니어) 모델이 CRATA의 강의·워크샵 사업과 정확히 겹침. 'AX 부트캠프(3~5일)'로 고객사 패턴 추출 → 온톨로지 → 스킬 → 업무사이트 데모까지 끝내는 상품화를 권함.
회의 자동 분류(Goal A) 쪽에서는 Notion AI Meeting Notes(한국어 전사, 오디오 업로드, 기본 DB 지정)와 Custom Agents(DB 이벤트 트리거)가 저비용 즉시 도입 경로임. 다만 이 조합은 아직 실제로 구현해 보지 않았고, 플라우드에서 오디오를 내보내 연결하는 부분은 별도로 확인이 필요함. CRATA 자체 온톨로지(사업부→프로젝트→과업)를 분류 기준표로 두고, 한 회의를 세그먼트 단위로 분류함.
주의: OpenAI Agent Builder는 2026.11.30 종료 예정이라 신규 의존은 피할 것. 대형 플랫폼(Palantir, Glean, Moveworks, Guru)은 가격이 비공개이고 대기업 영업 중심이라 중소 고객사에 직접 팔기는 어려움. 구조만 벤치마킹하는 대상임.
한국 쪽은 NAVER WORKS AI Studio(월 9,000원/인, 사내 게시판·메시지·드라이브 기반)와 CLOVA Note 업무용(회사 용어 사전, 폴더 분류)이 중소 고객사용 현실적 옵션임. 삼성SDS FabriX, SK AX AXgenticWire, 솔트룩스(온톨로지 특허 39건)는 '컨설팅→구축' 방법론의 참고 대상임. 이번 조사에서 웹 검색 한도가 소진되어 KT·카카오·LG CNS 제품명은 1차 출처로 확인하지 못했음.

services.name: Palantir AIP + Ontology
services.what_it_does: Models the whole organization as an Ontology (object types, properties, link types = nouns; action types, functions = verbs; plus security) and lets AIP agents/chatbots read objects and execute governed actions on top of it.
services.mechanism: Object/link/action schema over integrated datasets. AIP chatbots use tools (Action, Object Query, Function, Command, Request Clarification) and retrieval context (Ontology context via semantic top-K objects, document chunks, function-backed). Ontology MCP exposes objects, actions and queries to external agents with action restrictions. Captures decision lineage.
services.integration: Ontology MCP (MCP tools), Foundry APIs, Workshop apps
services.pricing_status: Active; enterprise contracts, pricing not public
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사 이해를 '명사(사람·부서·고객·문서·프로젝트와 관계)'와 '동사(결재·제안·보고 같은 액션)'로 나누는 틀을 그대로 차용할 것. 5일 부트캠프와 FDE 모델은 CRATA 강의·워크샵 사업과 결합해 'AX 부트캠프' 상품으로 만들기 좋음.

verification.note: Verified: Ontology MCP lets external agents read objects, run actions and query the ontology, limited by application restrictions. Chatbot Studio has Object query and Action tools. The five-day bootcamp is confirmed on palantir.com/platforms/aip/bootcamp.

services.name: Glean (Enterprise Graph, Personal Graph, Context Graph, Skills, Agents)
services.category: Enterprise search + work AI / context graph
services.what_it_does: Permission-aware search and agents over 275+ apps, grounded in an ML-inferred enterprise graph (projects, people, customers, products), per-user personal graphs, and (2026) a context graph that models how work actually happens.
services.mechanism: Deep connectors capture documents plus change events as traces. ML infers entities and relations, with activity signals (views, edits) on top. Personal graph groups low-level events into semantic tasks using signals plus LLMs. Anonymized personal graphs are aggregated to find repeated processes (~80% task-understanding accuracy claimed). Agent runs become new traces for reinforcement. Skills (beta, May 2026) package processes and support the open Agent Skills standard.
relevant_features: Context graph = entities + temporal traces of actions
Glean Skills created via chat/voice, importable from Anthropic/OpenAI/Cursor
Independent agents (June 2026) with identity, audit, kill switch
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사 '스타일·패턴 추출'의 정의로 Glean의 context graph를 그대로 빌릴 것. 핵심은 'why는 못 잡아도 how는 잡는다'는 관점으로, 문서 수정·회의·승인의 시간순 흔적에서 반복 업무 흐름을 뽑는 것임. 결과물은 Skills로 패키징함. 제품 자체는 중소 고객사에 비쌈.

verification.note: Verified: 275+ connectors; enterprise graph entities are projects, people, customers and products; personal graph infers tasks. Independent agents post dated June 30, 2026 (identity, audit, kill switch). The context data platform post is dated Jan 7, 2026.

services.name: Atlassian Rovo + Teamwork Graph
services.category: Work graph + AI agents for teamwork
services.what_it_does: Rovo (search, chat, agents, Studio, MCP server) is built on Teamwork Graph, which unifies Jira work items, Confluence pages, JSM requests, Loom videos and 100+ third-party connectors into objects and relationships among people, work, goals and knowledge.
services.mechanism: Unified data model of objects and relationships (documents to work items, messages to projects, users to teams), queryable through a single GraphQL endpoint. Third-party data enters via connectors. Graph is used for personalization and collaboration-pattern detection.
relevant_features: Included in Atlassian cloud paid plans
services.integration: GraphQL API, connectors, MCP server, CLI
services.pricing_status: Active; Rovo included with Atlassian cloud paid plans
services.takeaway_for_crata: '사람-업무-목표-지식' 4축 관계 모델은 고객사 업무사이트의 데이터 구조로 바로 참고할 만함. 고객사가 Jira나 Confluence를 쓰면 새로 만들지 말고 Rovo와 Teamwork Graph 위에 얹는 쪽이 비용상 유리함.

verification.note: Verified: 100 built-in connectors plus custom ones, a GraphQL API (Cypher also mentioned), and a Rovo/Atlassian Remote MCP server. Rovo comes with Standard, Premium and Enterprise cloud plans, but as monthly credit allowances (e.g. Jira/Confluence Standard gets 25 credits/user/month). Extra usage costs $0.01 per credit.

services.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Work IQ, Microsoft Graph, Copilot connectors, Cowork)
services.category: Productivity suite AI + workplace intelligence layer
services.what_it_does: Grounds Copilot and agents in emails, files, meetings, chats and org relationships via Microsoft Graph and Work IQ (data + memory + inference). Work IQ API (A2A, remote MCP, REST) is usage-billed for custom agents.
services.mechanism: Microsoft Graph plus semantic index for retrieval. Work IQ assembles context internally and exposes ~10 generic MCP tools (fetch/create/update over resource paths), with runtime schema discovery and a Rego policy engine enforcing user-scoped access. Copilot connectors are either synced (indexed into Graph with semantic labels) or federated (MCP, no data movement).
relevant_features: Work IQ MCP with 10 generic tools
Teams meeting transcription and action items
services.integration: Work IQ API (A2A/MCP/REST), Copilot connectors, Copilot Studio
services.pricing_status: Active; Copilot Premium add-on per user plus usage-based Work IQ API and Cowork
services.takeaway_for_crata: MS 365를 쓰는 고객사에는 업무사이트를 따로 만들기보다 Work IQ MCP와 연동하는 편이 저렴함. 커넥터의 'synced(색인) vs federated(MCP 실시간 조회)' 구분은 중소 고객 데이터 보안 설계에 그대로 적용 가능함.

verification.note: Verified: the Ignite 2025 blog defines Work IQ as data + memory + inference. The Work IQ MCP has 10 generic tools. The Work IQ API (A2A, remote MCP, REST) is billed by usage, separately from Copilot licenses. Cowork is usage-billed under the Premium license. Connectors come in two types: synced and federated (MCP). The M365 Copilot app is now called 'Microsoft Copilot'.

services.name: Notion AI (Notion Agent, Custom Agents, AI Meeting Notes, Enterprise Search)
services.what_it_does: Notion 3.0 (Sept 18, 2025) added agents that do multi-step work across pages and databases with editable instruction pages as memory. Custom Agents run on schedules, database events or Slack triggers. AI Meeting Notes transcribes and summarizes, supports Korean and uploaded audio.
services.mechanism: Agents act only on granted pages, databases and connectors. Memory is an editable instruction page. Meeting notes can be routed into a default database, and Custom Agents can trigger on page creation or property updates in that database.
relevant_features: AI Meeting Notes: Korean transcription, upload AAC/M4A/MP3/WAV
Custom Agents triggered by DB events/schedules/Slack
services.integration: MCP, AI connectors (Slack, Google Drive, GitHub...), API
services.korean_support: Korean transcription supported; speaker labels English only
services.pricing_status: Active; Business/Enterprise plan required for AI Meeting Notes and Custom Agents; credits-based agents
services.takeaway_for_crata: Goal A(회의 자동 분류)를 가장 싸게 시험해 볼 수 있는 후보임. 플라우드 오디오나 전사본을 Notion '회의 DB'에 넣고, Custom Agent가 'CRATA 온톨로지 페이지(사업부→프로젝트→과업)'를 기준으로 세그먼트 분류와 관계형 속성 태깅, 후속 과업 생성까지 처리하는 구성임. 고객사 업무사이트의 MVP 플랫폼으로도 쓸 수 있음.

verification.note: Verified: Notion 3.0 launched Sept 18, 2025 and uses instruction pages as a 'memory bank'. Meeting Notes transcribes Korean, accepts uploaded AAC/M4A/MP3/WAV, and supports a default database. Custom Agents and Meeting Notes need Business/Enterprise. Credits cost $10 per 1,000, but the May 3, 2026 start date doesn't appear on the pricing page.

services.name: Dust
services.category: Multi-model agent platform on company knowledge
services.what_it_does: Lets teams build and share agents over company data (70+ connectors) with spaces for access control, reusable Skills, per-user agent memory, triggers and MCP.
services.mechanism: Spaces (default Company Data space + open/restricted spaces) scope both data and which users can use an agent. Skills package instructions, MCP tools and knowledge, can nest sub-skills and are dynamically enabled. Agent memory is private per user. Tables can be queried.
relevant_features: Spaces: agent visibility = its spaces' membership
services.integration: 70+ connectors, MCP servers, Dust MCP server, API
services.korean_support: Multi-model; Korean via underlying LLMs (not explicitly confirmed)
services.pricing_status: Active; Business Pro EUR 24/mo (yearly) per seat, Max EUR 120; Enterprise custom
services.takeaway_for_crata: '공간(사업부별) + 공통 Company Data + 스킬' 3단 구조는 CRATA 내부(강의·워크샵/학맞통/아라)와 고객사 업무사이트 설계의 기본 틀로 쓰기 좋음. 중소 고객사에는 좌석당 가격이 현실적이라 바로 도입도 검토할 만함.

verification.note: Verified: Pro EUR 24/month billed yearly or EUR 30 monthly; Max EUR 120 yearly or EUR 150 monthly. Agent memory is private to each user, and Skills have version history. The homepage says 70+ connectors, but the Business plan lists '20+ integrations'; unlimited connectors are Enterprise-only.

services.name: WRITER (Knowledge Graph, AI Studio, Palmyra)
services.category: Enterprise generative AI platform with graph-based RAG
services.what_it_does: Graph-based RAG (Knowledge Graph) over files, URLs and connectors feeding proprietary Palmyra LLMs. AI Studio provides governed no-code agents with Playbooks and Skills plus usage and cost governance.
services.mechanism: A specialized LLM builds semantic relationships between data points into a graph (not only vectors), with retrieval-aware compression and metadata. Graphs are org-wide or team-scoped via API and attached to no-code agents.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사 문서 사이의 관계(제안서-계약-보고서)를 그래프로 저장하는 아이디어와 '팀 단위 지식그래프' 설계를 참고할 것. 플레이북별 사용량과 비용 대시보드는 고객사 업무사이트의 관리자 화면 기능으로 넣을 만함.

verification.note: Verified: Knowledge Graph does graph-based RAG with a /v1/graphs REST API, file and URL sources, and team assignment. AI Studio covers governance of Playbooks and Skills plus usage and cost dashboards.

services.name: Sana (Sana Agents, Sana Learn) — acquired by Workday
services.category: Enterprise knowledge agents + AI learning platform
services.what_it_does: Sana Agents search across enterprise systems, create documents and automate workflows. Sana Learn combines LMS, content creation, course generation and tutoring. Workday agreed to acquire Sana on Sept 16, 2025 for ~$1.1B.
services.mechanism: Agents with enterprise connectors (Workday, Google Drive, SharePoint) plus meeting assistant; course generation from internal knowledge (customer case: 4 months to 4 days).
relevant_features: Now part of Workday ('new front door for work')
services.pricing_status: Acquired by Workday (announced Sept 16, 2025; expected close by Jan 2026)
services.takeaway_for_crata: '사내 지식 → 교육과정 자동 생성'은 CRATA 강의·워크샵 사업과 직결됨. 고객사 패턴을 추출한 결과로 그 회사 전용 AI 교육 커리큘럼까지 자동 생성하는 상품 구조를 벤치마킹할 것.

verification.note: The researcher's 'expected close by Jan 2026' is out of date: the deal closed Nov 4, 2025. The product is now 'Sana from Workday', and sana.ai still offers Sana Agents (chat, search, meetings).
verification.source: https://newsroom.workday.com/ (Workday Completes Acquisition of Sana - Nov 4, 2025)

services.name: Anthropic Claude (Agent Skills, Projects, connectors)
services.what_it_does: Agent Skills (Oct 16, 2025) are folders with SKILL.md (YAML name/description), scripts and resources, loaded by progressive disclosure across Claude apps, Claude Code and the API. Projects hold knowledge and instructions with RAG for large knowledge. Org-provisioned skills on Team/Enterprise plans.
services.mechanism: Only skill name and description are preloaded. The SKILL.md body loads when relevant, and bundled files or code load on demand. Projects provide static knowledge, MCP connectors provide tools, and skills provide procedures. Example: a brand-guidelines skill applied to all documents and slides.
services.integration: Claude apps, API (/v1/skills), Claude Code plugins, MCP connectors
services.takeaway_for_crata: Goal B의 산출물 형식으로 가장 적합함. 고객사별로 '문서 스타일, 용어집, 결재 및 보고 흐름, 템플릿'을 SKILL.md 묶음으로 납품하는 방식임. CRATA 내부도 사업부별 스킬(학맞통 제안서, 강의안, 아라 스펙)과 Project를 만들면 플라우드 전사본을 붙여넣는 수작업이 크게 줄어듦.

verification.note: Verified: Owners on Team/Enterprise can provision skills org-wide; partner skills include Notion, Figma and Atlassian. Projects switch to RAG automatically on paid plans (up to 10x capacity). Correction: Skills is also on the Free plan, not only Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise.

services.name: ChatGPT Enterprise/Business (company knowledge, connectors, custom GPTs) + AgentKit
services.category: LLM assistant with connectors + agent dev kit
services.what_it_does: Company knowledge (late 2025) lets ChatGPT Business/Enterprise/Edu answer from connected apps with citations, respecting permissions. AgentKit (DevDay Oct 2025) bundles Agent Builder, ChatKit, connector registry and evals. Agent Builder is now being deprecated (shutdown Nov 30, 2026); ChatKit remains.
services.mechanism: Connector-based retrieval over Slack, Drive, SharePoint, GitHub and others with citations. Agent Builder was a node-based visual workflow canvas, published as versioned workflows embedded via ChatKit or the Agents SDK. Plugins now combine MCP servers + skills + optional UI.
services.pricing_status: Active; Agent Builder scheduled to shut down Nov 30, 2026
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사 업무사이트에 채팅 UI를 넣을 때 ChatKit은 쓸 수 있지만, Agent Builder 기반 워크플로는 종료 예정이니 새로 만들지 말 것. 스킬과 MCP 같은 이식 가능한 표준 위에 설계해야 플랫폼 교체 리스크가 줄어듦.

verification.note: Agent Builder deprecation (shutdown Nov 30, 2026) is confirmed, and ChatKit stays. The developers.openai.com/apps-sdk link now goes to the 'Plugins' docs. Two openai.com pages (company knowledge, AgentKit) returned 403, so those details weren't re-checked from the primary source.

services.name: Google Gemini Enterprise (successor to Agentspace)
services.what_it_does: Launched Oct 9, 2025 as 'front door for AI in the workplace': Gemini models, no-code workbench, prebuilt agents (Deep Research, Data Insights), connectors to Workspace, M365, Salesforce, SAP, and central agent governance.
services.mechanism: Permission-aware enterprise search and grounding over Google and third-party sources. Custom skill creation is available in most editions, and custom no-code agents in Standard/Plus. Editions: Business (1-500 users), Standard, Plus, Pay-as-you-go, Frontline.
services.integration: Connectors (Workspace, M365, Salesforce, SAP), agent gallery, partner agents
services.korean_support: Korean supported via Gemini (not explicitly confirmed on page)
services.pricing_status: Active; editions listed, prices not on fetched page
services.takeaway_for_crata: Google Workspace를 쓰는 고객사라면 Business 에디션(500명 이하)에 CRATA가 만든 스킬과 에이전트를 얹는 구성이 현실적임. 플랫폼은 Google 것을 쓰고 CRATA는 '회사 이해(스킬, 온톨로지)'를 공급하는 역할 분담임.

verification.note: Verified: launched Oct 9, 2025 as the 'front door for AI in the workplace', with Deep Research and Data Insights agents and Workspace/M365/Salesforce/SAP connectors. The old Agentspace product URL now lands on the 'Gemini Enterprise app' page. Editions are Business, Standard, Plus, Pay-as-you-go and Frontline; custom skills and the no-code agent builder are in every edition except Frontline.

services.name: Moveworks (now ServiceNow)
services.category: Employee support AI assistant / enterprise search
services.what_it_does: Agentic AI assistant for employees (IT/HR requests, search across 50+ systems) with a Reasoning Engine and Agent Studio; now part of ServiceNow as 'one AI front door for work'.
services.mechanism: A reasoning engine orchestrates LLMs and built-in tools to plan, execute and adapt. Enterprise search runs over Slack, OneDrive, Drive, SharePoint, Confluence and others. Marketplace of 1000+ agents. Claims value within ~8 weeks of deployment.
services.pricing_status: Acquired by ServiceNow (deal announced 2025; site states acquisition completed)
services.takeaway_for_crata: 대기업 IT·HR 헬프데스크용이라 CRATA의 중소 고객에는 맞지 않음. 다만 '8주 내 가치 실현'처럼 도입 기간을 약속하는 패키징 방식은 참고할 만함.

verification.note: Acquisition by ServiceNow has closed ('ServiceNow officially acquires Moveworks'). Site confirms 50+ systems and 100+ languages.

services.name: Guru
services.what_it_does: Structures scattered knowledge into a verified source of truth and serves it to people and AI tools (Slack, Teams, Claude, browser). Knowledge Agents detect conflicts, merge duplicates, flag stale content and route corrections to SMEs.
services.mechanism: Card/knowledge verification workflows with owners, plus quality automation (conflict and gap detection, auto-verify by usage, draft updates), permission-aware answers with citations and audit trails.
relevant_features: Packages include knowledge architecture design services
services.pricing_status: Active; custom packages (no public per-seat price)
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사 '회사 이해 문서(온톨로지, 스킬)'에 담당자·검증일·유효기간 필드를 두고 주기적으로 재검증하는 운영 방식을 차용할 것. 플랫폼 구축 후 유지보수 구독 상품의 근거가 됨.

verification.note: Verified: Knowledge Agents find conflicting versions, merge duplicates, flag stale content and route issues to experts. Knowledge reaches Claude (via MCP), Slack and Teams. No per-seat price; custom packages include knowledge architecture design.

services.name: Allganize Alli (Alli Coworker, Alli Works)
services.category: Enterprise LLM app/agent builder, on-prem RAG
