services.what_it_does: Alli Coworker is a no-code builder for employees to create AI agents in natural language (web/Slack/Teams). Alli Works is a preconfigured agent for document-heavy tasks (contract review, RFP analysis). Supports SaaS, on-prem and air-gapped deployment.
services.mechanism: RAG with cited source locations and preserved document layout, multi-model (GPT/Claude/Gemini/Llama/fine-tuned), plus app versioning, staging and rollback. Data Assist Agent analyzes large Excel files (Dec 2025).
relevant_features: Strong Japan enterprise base (NTT Docomo, KDDI, Tokyo Metro)
services.takeaway_for_crata: 보안이 중요한 공공·금융 고객(학맞통 관련 교육청 등)에는 온프레미스 가능한 국산 플랫폼 옵션으로 제안 가능함. 앱 버전관리와 스테이징 개념은 고객사 업무사이트 운영 정책에도 참고할 만함.

verification.note: Verified: Alli Coworker builds agents from plain language with no code; Alli Works is a ready-made document agent. Deployment can be SaaS, on-prem or hybrid, including fully air-gapped. Japanese customers include NTT Docomo, KDDI, JAL, ANA and Tokyo Metro.

services.name: Upstage (Document Parse, Information Extract, Solar LLM, Studio)
services.what_it_does: Document Parse converts PDFs, scans and emails into machine-readable text (>95% accuracy claimed). Information Extract pulls structured fields. Solar Pro 4 (Aug 2026) is an agentic LLM and Solar Mini 4 a 3B-active compact model. Studio builds document-workflow agents.
services.mechanism: Layout-aware document parsing and schema-based extraction feeding RAG and agents. Solar models offered via Console API, AWS/Azure marketplaces or on-prem.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사 스타일 추출의 1단계(기존 보고서·제안서·양식 PDF/HWP 대량 파싱)에 부품으로 쓰기 좋음. 파싱 결과에서 제목 체계, 표 양식, 문체를 통계로 뽑아 스킬로 변환하는 파이프라인을 만들 수 있음.

verification.note: Verified: Solar Pro 4 announced Aug 20, 2026; Solar Mini 4 has 3B active parameters. Correction: '>95% accuracy' comes from a Hanwha Life customer testimonial about OCR, not an official Document Parse spec.

services.name: Saltlux (LUXIA platform, Goover)
services.category: Sovereign AI / LLM + ontology & knowledge graph
services.what_it_does: Full-stack Korean AI vendor: LUXIA LLM and platform with studios (Document, Agent, Search, A.RAG, Voice, Knowledge), ontology and knowledge-graph systems (39 ontology patents), and Goover (AI search, briefing, reports, agents) for individuals.
services.mechanism: Ontology/knowledge-graph plus LLM RAG studios on LUXIA Cloud, serving public, finance, defense and education sectors.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 국내에서 '온톨로지 기반 기업 지식' 영업 언어를 가장 오래 써 온 회사임. 공공·교육 고객 대상 제안서에서 온톨로지 접근을 설명할 때 레퍼런스로 활용할 수 있음.

verification.note: Verified: 39 ontology-related patents, the Luxia Cloud platform, and Goover as a consumer service. The homepage says ten studio-based services, so the researcher's list of six is incomplete.

services.name: Samsung SDS FabriX (and Brity Works/Copilot)
services.what_it_does: FabriX connects corporate knowledge and systems for agent execution, with no-code (NL prompt), low-code (visual workflow) and pro-code agent building, an internal agent Store, multi-model chat, Deep Research agent and an AI Editor.
services.mechanism: MCP for CRM/ERP/DB connections, OpenAPI embedding, on-prem/private configs, PII filtering, RBAC on assets. In Sept 2026 SDS announced Anthropic Claude Partner Network Select tier status.
services.takeaway_for_crata: '사내 에이전트 스토어'로 부서마다 만든 에이전트를 공유하는 구조는 고객사 업무사이트의 핵심 메뉴로 넣을 만함. 중소 규모 버전으로 '우리 회사 스킬·에이전트 갤러리' 페이지를 구성하는 식임.

verification.note: Verified: no-code, low-code and pro-code agent building; Agent Store; multiple LLMs (including Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini); Deep Research agent; MCP integration; PII filtering; cloud, hybrid or on-prem. AI Editor wasn't seen on the page.

services.name: SK AX AXgenticWire
services.what_it_does: Flagship agentic-AI brand covering Service, Model & Agentic Assets, Platform, LLM, Data and Infrastructure layers, delivered as consulting followed by implementation.
services.mechanism: Agent Builder with quality management and human-in-the-loop, multi-LLM optimization per use case, 'AI-readable' data governance, serverless infrastructure. Positions AX as optimizing decision-making and resource allocation, not just adopting tools.
services.takeaway_for_crata: '컨설팅 → 구축 → 인재 교육'의 3단 패키지는 CRATA 사업 구조(강의·워크샵 + 구축)와 같은 모양임. 대기업 SI의 표현과 단계 구성을 중소기업용으로 축소해 차용할 수 있음.

verification.note: Verified: the six layers (Service, Model & Agentic Assets, Platform, LLM, Data, Infrastructure) belong to AXO (AX Optimization Offering). Human-in-the-loop is part of the Platform layer's Agent Builder. The Service layer is consulting plus implementation.

services.name: NAVER WORKS AI Studio + CLOVA Note (business)
services.category: Korean groupware AI assistant + AI meeting minutes
services.what_it_does: AI Studio is a company-specific assistant ('우리 회사를 가장 잘 아는 AI') that searches in-house boards, messages and drive plus web. Users can build their own assistants. CLOVA Note business records meetings, separates speakers and summarizes, with folders and a custom company dictionary.
services.mechanism: RAG over NAVER WORKS data with admin/user permission settings, built on HyperCLOVA X (THINK, SEED models). CLOVA Note supports a custom terminology dictionary to improve recognition of company terms. Customer data is not used for training.
relevant_features: CLOVA Note business tiers from KRW 18,000/month
services.integration: NAVER WORKS suite (mail, messenger, drive, boards)
services.pricing_status: Active; AI Studio KRW 9,000/user/month; CLOVA Note Lite KRW 18,000 to Business Plus KRW 1,651,000/month
services.takeaway_for_crata: 국내 중소 고객사가 이미 네이버웍스를 쓰고 있다면 가장 싸고 빠른 '회사 이해 AI' 옵션임. CLOVA Note의 '회사 용어 사전' 아이디어는 플라우드 전사 품질 개선(학맞통, 아라 등 고유명사)에도 그대로 적용할 수 있음.

verification.note: Verified: AI Studio costs KRW 9,000/user/month on annual contracts and searches boards, messages and drive. Mail search is planned for 2026. CLOVA Note business tiers: Lite 18,000, Team 86,500, Business 423,000, Business Plus 1,651,000 KRW/month. Custom company dictionary confirmed; folders not mentioned on the page.

services.name: LG CNS AX consulting
services.what_it_does: Positions AX consulting as the successor to DX, with agentic AI that plans, executes and evaluates, delivered through industry and workflow understanding plus partnerships with AI model and cloud companies.
services.mechanism: Consulting-led and industry-specific. No named agent platform was found on the fetched public pages.
relevant_features: Emphasis on understanding existing workflows/systems first
services.takeaway_for_crata: 대기업 SI도 '기존 업무 흐름과 시스템 이해가 먼저'라고 강조함. CRATA의 '회사 스타일·패턴 추출' 단계를 별도 유료 진단 상품으로 분리할 근거가 됨.

verification.note: Verified the description of agentic AI as planning, executing and evaluating. The page doesn't mention partnerships with AI model or cloud companies. It talks about partnering with 'AX experts, not just technology providers' and 40+ years of SI and cloud experience.

services.name: 42Maru (QA42, CHAT42)
services.what_it_does: Deep semantic QA platform for enterprise knowledge (QA42), conversational chatbot (CHAT42) and NLP (NL42); clients include LG U+, SK Innovation, KT, Nonghyup Bank, Kia.
services.mechanism: Machine reading comprehension QA over unstructured documents (SQuAD 2.0 #1 heritage).
services.pricing_status: Active (public site content appears dated; 2025-2026 LLM product names not verified)
services.takeaway_for_crata: 최신 LLM 및 에이전트 제품 정보를 1차 출처로 확인하지 못했음. 참고 우선순위는 낮음.

verification.note: Site footer says (c)2026 and lists QA42, CHAT42, NL42 and the named clients. No newer LLM or RAG product names are listed, so how current the site is remains unclear.

methods.name: 명사-동사 경량 온톨로지 (Palantir-style lightweight ontology)
methods.description: Model a company as object types + properties + link types (nouns) and action types (verbs) plus permissions, following Palantir's 'data, logic, action, security' decision framing. Lightweight version: a single YAML/JSON or Notion DB schema instead of a platform.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: CRATA 내부용: BusinessLine(강의·워크샵/학맞통/아라) → Project → Task → Meeting/Segment → Deliverable, Client, Person 객체를 두고 관계를 정의함. 액션은 '제안서 생성', '강의안 생성', '과업 등록' 등으로 정의함. 이 파일이 회의 자동 분류의 라벨 체계가 됨. 고객사용: 첫 1~2일에 부서, 문서 유형, 결재선, 고객/제품 객체와 '보고', '결재', '발주' 같은 액션을 1장짜리 온톨로지로 확정함.

methods.name: Context graph from traces (how, not why)
methods.description: Glean defines a context graph as enterprise entities connected with temporal traces of actions/events. Patterns are inferred from repeated, timestamped actions (edits, approvals, collaboration sequences) rather than from asking people why they do things; low-level events are grouped into tasks by signals plus LLMs.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 고객사 스타일·패턴 추출의 핵심 방법임. ① 최근 3~6개월 산출물(보고서, 제안서, 회의록, 메일 템플릿)과 버전 이력을 수집함. ② 시간순으로 '누가→무엇을→어떤 양식으로→누구에게'를 trace로 정리함. ③ LLM으로 반복 패턴(보고 주기, 문서 구조, 결재 단계, 자주 쓰는 표현)을 클러스터링함. ④ 결과를 현업 인터뷰로 검증함. 인터뷰를 먼저 하지 말고 흔적 분석을 먼저 하는 순서가 중요함.

methods.name: Skills 패키지 (SKILL.md, progressive disclosure)
methods.description: Package a company's procedures, style rules, templates and scripts as Agent Skills folders (SKILL.md with name/description frontmatter + reference files + code). Supported in Claude, and the pattern is mirrored by Glean Skills (open Agent Skills standard import), Dust Skills, Writer Playbooks/Skills and Gemini Enterprise custom skills.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 고객사별 납품물을 '스킬 묶음'으로 표준화함. 예: company-style(문체, 용어, 금칙어), report-format(보고서 목차·표 양식), approval-flow(결재 규칙), meeting-to-tasks(회의록에서 과업 추출). CRATA 내부도 hakmattong-proposal, workshop-lesson-plan, ara-spec 스킬을 만들어 두면, 플라우드 전사본을 넣었을 때 자동으로 알맞은 스킬이 로드됨. 표준 포맷이라 고객 플랫폼이 바뀌어도 재사용 가능함.

methods.name: Spaces 기반 권한·범위 설계
methods.description: Dust-style spaces: a default Company Data space visible to all plus open/restricted spaces; an agent's visibility equals the membership of the spaces it uses. Microsoft and Glean similarly enforce user-scoped, permission-aware retrieval.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: CRATA 내부는 사업부별 공간 3개(강의·워크샵/학맞통/아라)와 공통 공간으로 나눔. 회의 세그먼트를 분류한 뒤 해당 공간으로 라우팅함. 고객사 업무사이트도 '전사 공통 + 부서 공간' 2단으로 시작하고, 학생 정보처럼 민감한 데이터(학맞통)는 제한 공간에만 둠.

methods.name: Synced vs federated(MCP) 연결 전략
methods.description: Microsoft distinguishes synced connectors (index content into the graph with semantic labels) from federated connectors (query in real time via MCP, no data movement). Work IQ exposes ~10 generic verb tools over resource paths with runtime schema discovery and policy enforcement.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 중소 고객사에서는 모든 데이터를 복사해 색인하지 말고, 자주 쓰는 정적 문서(규정, 양식)만 색인함(synced). ERP나 학생 데이터처럼 민감하거나 자주 변하는 데이터는 MCP로 실시간 조회함(federated). 이렇게 나누면 구축비와 보안 부담이 함께 줄어듦.

methods.name: 부트캠프 + FDE 진입 모델
methods.description: Palantir onboards prospective customers via five-day AIP bootcamps that build real use cases on the customer's data, backed by forward-deployed engineers; SK AX and LG CNS likewise frame AX as consulting then implementation then talent development.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 'CRATA AX 부트캠프(3~5일)'로 상품화함. Day1 데이터 수집·trace 분석, Day2 온톨로지 확정, Day3 스킬 작성·에이전트 구성, Day4 현업 워크샵(강의 사업과 결합), Day5 업무사이트 데모. 이후 FDE처럼 1명이 주 1회 상주하는 유지 구독으로 연결함.

methods.name: 검증 가능한 지식 운영 (verification loop)
methods.description: Guru assigns owners and verification to knowledge, auto-flags stale or conflicting content and routes corrections to SMEs. Glean reinforces successful agent traces, and Notion and Dust keep editable instruction or memory pages.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 온톨로지와 스킬 파일마다 owner, last_verified, valid_until 필드를 넣음. 에이전트 결과에 대한 현업 피드백(👍/수정본)을 모아 월 1회 스킬을 개정함. 이 과정이 CRATA의 월 구독형 유지보수 서비스의 실체가 됨.

methods.name: 회의 → DB → 트리거 에이전트 파이프라인
methods.description: Meeting notes land in a default database; database-event-triggered agents (Notion Custom Agents) or scheduled agents (Dust, Glean) then classify and act. CLOVA Note adds a custom company dictionary for better recognition of in-house terms.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 플라우드 전사본이나 오디오를 '회의 DB'에 적재하면, 트리거 에이전트가 온톨로지 기준으로 토픽 세그먼트를 나누고 세그먼트별로 사업부·프로젝트·과업을 태깅함. 이어서 해당 스킬로 산출물 초안(제안서, 강의안, 과업 목록)을 만들고 담당 공간에 저장함. 전사 단계에는 '학맞통, 아라, 크라타' 등 고유명사 사전을 적용함.

claim_verdicts.claim: Palantir's Ontology treats objects/links as 'the nouns' and actions as 'the verbs' of the enterprise, modeling decisions as data + logic + action + security.
claim_verdicts.correction: The page says it word for word: 'If the data elements in the Ontology are "the nouns" of the enterprise... then the actions can be considered "the verbs"', and 'Palantir models each operational decision as comprising four components: Data, Logic, Action, and Security'.

claim_verdicts.claim: Palantir onboards prospective customers with five-day AIP boot camps.
claim_verdicts.correction: Palantir's own page confirms this, so Wikipedia isn't the only source: 'an interactive workshop where customers go from 0 to use case in 5 days' and 'Run a five-day AIP Bootcamp'.

claim_verdicts.claim: Glean defines a context graph as 'a model that connects your enterprise entities with temporal traces of actions and events between them' and infers processes from aggregated, anonymized personal graphs.
claim_verdicts.correction: The full definition puts '(people, documents, tickets, systems)' after 'entities'. For process analysis, Glean normalizes 'each personal graph... into a sequence of anonymized steps' and computes similarity across those steps.

claim_verdicts.claim: Glean Skills (beta, May 2026) can be created via chat or voice and imported from Anthropic/OpenAI/Cursor via the open Agent Skills standard.
claim_verdicts.correction: Post last updated May 5, 2026. Skills is in beta, and an admin has to turn it on in the admin console.

claim_verdicts.claim: Anthropic launched Agent Skills on Oct 16, 2025: folders with SKILL.md, scripts and resources loaded via progressive disclosure, portable across Claude apps, Claude Code and API, with org-wide provisioning on Team/Enterprise.
claim_verdicts.correction: Small timing point: org-wide skill management came in a December 18, 2025 update, not at launch. The support article now lists Skills on the Free, Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans (code execution must be on), and Owners on Team/Enterprise can provision skills for all users (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512176-what-are-skills).

claim_verdicts.claim: Notion AI Meeting Notes supports Korean transcription, uploaded audio (AAC/M4A/MP3/WAV) and a default meetings database. Custom Agents can trigger on database events and require a Business/Enterprise plan.
claim_verdicts.correction: All parts check out. Extra details: Custom Agent triggers also include comments, schedules, Slack events and 'AI Meeting Notes completion'. Custom Agents have a free trial on every plan, and after that cost $10 per 1,000 Notion credits (pricing page).

claim_verdicts.claim: OpenAI is deprecating Agent Builder (AgentKit) with shutdown scheduled for November 30, 2026; ChatKit remains available.
claim_verdicts.correction: Quote: 'OpenAI is deprecating Agent Builder... scheduled to shut down on November 30, 2026. ChatKit remains available.'

claim_verdicts.claim: Workday signed a definitive agreement on Sept 16, 2025 to acquire Sana for about $1.1B. NAVER WORKS AI Studio is priced at KRW 9,000 per user per month (annual).
claim_verdicts.correction: Both parts are correct, but the deal has since closed: Workday completed the acquisition on Nov 4, 2025 (Workday newsroom: 'Workday Completes Acquisition of Sana'), and the product is now called 'Sana from Workday'. The NAVER AI Studio price of KRW 9,000/user/month is for annual contracts. The page gives no monthly-contract price.

summary_ko:
1) 시장은 '스타일을 한 번 정의 → AI가 생성 시 자동 적용 → 생성 후 위반 검사'의 3단 구조로 수렴했습니다. 텍스트 쪽은 WRITER(보이스 프로필+용어 목록+스타일 가이드 결합), Jasper(Brand IQ), Markup AI(구 Acrolinx, Content Guardian Agents)가 있고, 시각·문서 쪽은 Microsoft 365 Copilot Brand Kit, Templafy, Frontify, Canva 브랜드 템플릿이 있습니다.
2) 웹사이트에서 시각 스타일을 자동으로 뽑는 일은 이미 API·오픈소스로 상품화돼 있습니다. Firecrawl의 branding 포맷은 색·폰트·간격·컴포넌트·로고에 더해 'personality'까지 돌려줍니다. brand.dev(현 context.dev)는 styleguide 추출 엔드포인트를, Brandfetch는 보이스·포지셔닝을 담은 Brand Context API를, Dembrandt(MIT)는 DTCG 토큰·Tailwind·shadcn·브랜드가이드 PDF를 제공합니다. 시각 토큰 추출은 CRATA가 직접 개발할 필요 없이 조립하면 됩니다.
3) 표준 포맷도 굳어졌습니다. 디자인 토큰은 W3C DTCG(2025.10 첫 stable)이고, Style Dictionary로 CSS·Tailwind 등으로 변환합니다. AI 에이전트용 스타일 문서는 Google Stitch의 DESIGN.md, Lovable의 design-system.json+system.md, Anthropic의 SKILL.md(brand-guidelines) 형태가 쓰입니다. CRATA는 고객사마다 'Style Pack' 폴더(tokens.json, voice-card, glossary.csv, doc-archetypes.json, 템플릿 원본, DESIGN.md/SKILL.md)를 표준으로 잡는 것을 권합니다.
4) 사이트를 만드는 도구(Lovable Build with URL·Design systems, v0 registry, Stitch, Figma Make kits, Relume)는 모두 '디자인 시스템 컨텍스트를 먼저 주입'하는 방식입니다. 그래서 추출한 Style Pack을 그대로 넣으면 고객사 업무 포털 시안을 빠르게 만들 수 있습니다.
5) 한국 고객사, 특히 학교·공공(학맞통 대상)에서는 HWP/HWPX 문서 양식이 핵심입니다. Upstage Document Parse(HWP/HWPX 지원, 페이지당 $0.01), 한컴 hwpx-owpml-model, python-hwpx로 양식을 파싱하고 KRDS(정부 디자인 시스템 토큰)를 기본값으로 쓰는 것이 현실적입니다.
6) 한국어 보이스 카드에는 영어권 도구에 없는 축(종결어미: 합니다/해요/개조식 '-함·-음', 존칭 체계, 결재·보고 문체, 한자어 비율)을 반드시 넣어야 합니다. Kiwi 형태소 분석으로 이 축들을 정량화할 수 있습니다.
7) WRITER Enterprise Brain(2026-09-09 발표)은 회의(WRITER Meet)·Slack에서 결정과 선호를 뽑아 회사 컨텍스트 그래프로 쌓습니다. 이는 CRATA의 목표 A(Plaud 회의 분류)와 목표 B(회사 패턴 추출)를 하나로 잇는 벤치마크입니다.
8) 한계: 이번 세션은 검색 한도가 소진돼 공식 문서를 직접 열람하는 방식으로 조사했습니다. 한국 전용 '브랜드 보이스 AI/브랜드 가이드 자동추출' 스타트업은 검증된 사례를 찾지 못했습니다. 미리캔버스·망고보드 공식 페이지에서도 브랜드 키트 기능은 확인되지 않았습니다. 이 공백은 CRATA에게 기회일 수 있습니다.

services.name: WRITER (Voice profiles · Terminology · Style guide · Enterprise Brain)
services.what_it_does: Lets admins define voice profiles per brand/channel/persona and attach terminology lists (approved/restricted terms) and style guides (casing, punctuation, readability). Enterprise Brain (announced 2026-09-09) builds a shared context graph from meetings (WRITER Meet), Slack and Teams plus uploaded brand guidelines.
services.mechanism: Rules-based plus LLM (Palmyra) enforcement inside generation and review. A legacy API exposes terminology CRUD, styleguide pages and snippets. Enterprise Brain structures decisions and preferences from live conversations into team-level agent memory.
relevant_features: Terminology lists linked to voice profiles
Enterprise Brain: decisions extracted from meetings/Slack
services.integration: REST API & SDKs, MCP connectors, Slack/Teams, Agent Builder
services.takeaway_for_crata: '보이스 프로필 1개에 용어 목록과 스타일 가이드를 붙이는' 데이터 모델을 그대로 벤치마크해 CRATA Style Pack 스키마로 쓰면 됩니다. Enterprise Brain처럼 Plaud 회의록에서 '결정·선호·말버릇'을 뽑아 고객사 컨텍스트에 누적하는 구조가 목표 A와 B를 잇는 핵심 아이디어입니다.

verification.note: Terms lists and style guides on voice profiles confirmed (May 2026). The legacy Terminology, Styleguide and Snippet APIs are still documented. Enterprise Brain was announced 2026-09-09: its context graph is built from WRITER Meet, and Teams is in early access.

services.name: Jasper Brand IQ (Brand Voice, Style Guide, Visual Guidelines) / Product IQ
services.what_it_does: Brand IQ bundles Brand Voice, Style Guide (grammar/style automation) and Visual Guidelines (color palettes, image styles, layout). It flags brand violations and suggests on-brand replacements. Product IQ (Aug 2026) adds governed product specs, claims and disclaimers.
services.mechanism: Workspace-level brand objects (voices, style guides, knowledge items, audiences) are injected as 'Brand IQ fields' into agent tasks, then checked by a violation-flagging pass.
services.pricing_status: Active; free trial plus business/enterprise tiers
services.takeaway_for_crata: Voice / Style Guide / Visual Guidelines / Knowledge / Audience 5분할은 CRATA의 고객사 스타일 카드 목차로 그대로 쓸 만합니다. '생성 후 위반 플래그와 대체안 제시' 단계를 아라 에이전트 출력 검수 단계로 넣는 것을 권합니다.

verification.note: Brand Voice, Style Guide and Visual Guidelines confirmed, along with violation flagging. Product IQ launched 2026-08-24. The API has full CRUD for voices and knowledge, but style guides and audiences are read-only.

services.name: Markup AI (formerly Acrolinx) — Content Guardian Agents
services.what_it_does: Acrolinx rebranded to Markup AI. Its agents (Style, Brand Terms, Brand Voice, Persona) check human and AI content against configured style guides, terminology and voice, and score consistency at scale.
services.mechanism: You configure brand voice, personas, terminology and style guide once in the console; agents run checks via API or MCP and return flags, suggestions and scores. Terminology import supports CSV or ACTIF XML.
relevant_features: Brand Voice Agent / Brand Voice Profiles API
services.integration: REST API, MCP server, Google Docs/Word/Figma/AEM/GitHub plugins, Zapier
services.pricing_status: Active (rebranded from Acrolinx); pricing not public
services.takeaway_for_crata: '생성 AI'와 '검수 AI(Guardian)'를 분리하는 아키텍처가 핵심입니다. 고객사 Style Pack을 기준으로 출력물을 채점하는 검수 에이전트를 MCP 도구로 만들면, 산출물(제안서, 강의안, 업무 사이트 문구) 품질을 정량적으로 관리할 수 있습니다. 용어집은 CSV로 표준화하세요.

verification.note: The Acrolinx to Markup AI rebrand and the agents are confirmed. Two corrections: pricing is public (self-serve Starter and Business plans with unlimited users, plus Enterprise and a 30-day trial), and the docs list about 13 apps plus Zapier, n8n, GitHub Actions and MCP, not 40+ integrations.

services.name: Grammarly for Business (style guides, brand tones) / Superhuman Go
services.what_it_does: Provides custom style guide uploads with context-aware suggestions, brand tone profiles and Knowledge Share (surfaces company info while typing). Enterprise is now delivered via 'Superhuman Go' with an AI assistant and agents.
services.mechanism: Org-level rules plus a tone-detection model run inline across 1M+ apps via extension.
services.integration: Browser/desktop extensions, Google Docs, Office, Slack, Salesforce
services.pricing_status: Active; Grammarly now part of the Superhuman brand for enterprise
services.takeaway_for_crata: 한국어 미지원이라 직접 도입은 어렵습니다. 다만 '직원이 타이핑하는 순간 회사 톤과 용어를 인라인으로 교정'하는 UX는 고객사 업무 사이트의 작성 화면에 넣을 만한 기능입니다.

verification.note: Confirmed: the page says Grammarly is now delivered through Superhuman Go, and the footer reads "© Superhuman Platform". Style guide upload, brand tones and Knowledge Share are all present.

services.name: Copy.ai (GTM AI Platform: Brand Voice + Infobase)
services.what_it_does: Pivoted to a GTM AI platform (workflows, agents, tables). Brand Voice defines company personality and Infobase stores company facts injected into outputs.
services.mechanism: Brand Voice plus an Infobase repository used as context in model-agnostic workflows (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini).
services.pricing_status: Active. Fullcast's site shows Copy.ai as a customer, not an acquisition
services.takeaway_for_crata: '보이스'와 '사실 정보(Infobase)'를 분리 저장하는 구조가 참고할 만합니다. CRATA Style Pack에서도 스타일(어떻게 말하나)과 지식(무엇을 말하나)을 분리하세요.

verification.note: The researcher's claim is wrong. Fullcast announced it acquired Copy.ai on 2025-10-15, and Copy.ai's support email is now copyaisupport@fullcast.com. Brand Voice and Infobase still exist.

services.name: Typeface Arc (Arc Graph / Brand Graph)
services.what_it_does: Arc Graph structures brand guidelines, approved assets, audiences and performance signals (Brand Graph + Knowledge Graph) so agents can generate and auto-validate on-brand content. Arc Loop feeds performance back.
services.mechanism: Captures logo usage, palettes, typography and imagery style from brand docs into a graph. Outputs are validated against it before publishing, with correction suggestions.
services.pricing_status: Active as independent company per 2026 site; pricing not public
services.takeaway_for_crata: 브랜드 가이드를 문서가 아니라 '그래프(규칙, 자산, 성과)'로 저장한다는 개념을 참고하세요. 고객사 스타일을 그래프(부서-문서유형-용어-톤)로 쌓으면 업무 사이트의 메뉴 구조(IA)까지 만들어낼 수 있습니다.

verification.note: Independent ("Copyright © 2026 Typeface Inc") with no acquisition in the newsroom. Arc Graph covers Brand Graph and Knowledge Graph with automatic checks. Typeface MCP and APIs exist. Figma/Photoshop connectors were not verified.

services.name: Firecrawl — branding format
services.what_it_does: scrape(url, formats=['branding']) returns a BrandingProfile: color scheme, logo, palette (primary/secondary/accent/background/semantic), fonts, typography, spacing, components (buttons/inputs), images, animations, layout and 'personality' (tone/audience traits).
services.mechanism: Renders the page and analyzes DOM/CSS plus LLM-derived personality. Branding Format v2 (2026-02-06) improved logo extraction.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사 홈페이지 URL 하나로 시각 토큰과 성격(personality) 초안을 얻는 1차 수집기로 바로 쓸 수 있습니다. 같은 크롤링 결과의 markdown 본문은 보이스·용어 추출 코퍼스로 재사용하세요.

verification.note: formats:['branding'] confirmed, including personality, components and layout. Branding Format v2 blog post dated 2026-02-06.

services.name: context.dev (formerly brand.dev) — Brand API & Styleguide extraction
services.what_it_does: Brand lookup by domain/name/email/ticker returns logos, colors, company details and socials. A dedicated 'Extract a styleguide' endpoint pulls colors, typography, spacing and component styles from a website, plus a screenshot endpoint.
services.mechanism: JS rendering with managed proxies, then computed-style analysis and a brand database lookup.
services.pricing_status: Active; brand.dev domain now redirects to context.dev (rebrand)
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사 담당자의 업무 이메일 도메인만으로 로고와 색 초안을 자동으로 채우는 '온보딩 자동화'에 쓸 수 있습니다. Firecrawl의 대안 또는 교차검증용으로 두세요.

verification.note: brand.dev returns a 301 to context.dev. The Extract Styleguide, Screenshot and Prefetch endpoints are confirmed. Company HQ not verified.

services.name: Brandfetch (Brand API, Logo API, Brand Context API, MCP)
services.what_it_does: Brand API returns logos, colors, fonts and company data for 50M+ brands (100 free requests). Logo API is free up to 1M req/month. Brand Context API gives AI agents identity, positioning, voice and visual style. Brandfetch MCP is available.
services.mechanism: Brand-submitted profiles plus data extracted from official sites, reviewed by humans. Supports pay-per-request (x402/MPP).
services.korean_support: Coverage of Korean SMEs/schools likely limited (not confirmed)
services.takeaway_for_crata: 대기업 고객사라면 Brand Context API로 보이스와 포지셔닝 초안을 즉시 받을 수 있습니다. 다만 국내 중소기업이나 학교는 DB에 없을 가능성이 커서 직접 크롤링하는 파이프라인이 주력이어야 합니다.

verification.note: 50M+ brands, 100 free Brand API requests and a free Logo API up to 1M requests/month confirmed. The Brand Context API covers voice, positioning and style. Brandfetch MCP is listed in the docs, and pay-per-request via x402 is also offered.

services.name: Dembrandt (open source)
services.what_it_does: Extracts colors, typography, spacing, borders, shadows, motion, components, breakpoints and icons from any website in one command. Outputs W3C DTCG tokens, JSON, Tailwind v4 theme, shadcn/ui theme, an HTML report or a brand guide PDF.
services.mechanism: Playwright renders the page and computed DOM styles are analyzed with color confidence scoring, typography grouping and spacing scale detection. Multi-page merge, WCAG contrast audit and drift comparison in CI.
services.takeaway_for_crata: CRATA 파이프라인의 '시각 토큰 추출' 단계에 바로 쓸 수 있는 핵심 부품입니다. DTCG와 shadcn 출력을 그대로 업무 사이트 생성(Lovable/v0/Claude Code)에 넣을 수 있고, 브랜드가이드 PDF는 고객 검증 미팅 자료로 활용하세요.

verification.note: MIT, about 3.6k stars, v0.37.0. DTCG, Tailwind v4, shadcn, PDF and HTML outputs, WCAG checks, dark mode, crawl, drift detection and MCP all confirmed. The 'cloud dashboard' was not verified.

services.name: Project Wallace (CSS analytics & design token audit)
services.what_it_does: Full CSS analysis plus a 'design token audit' that extracts every color, font-size, shadow and spacing value and groups them to expose inconsistency and drift.
services.mechanism: Static CSS parsing and statistics (counts and frequency), no LLM.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 빈도 기반 통계로 '실제로 많이 쓰는 값'을 고르는 보조 검증 도구입니다. 고객사 사이트가 일관성이 없을 때 정리 제안(컨설팅 포인트)의 근거 자료로 쓰기 좋습니다.

verification.note: The design token audit (colors, font sizes, shadows, spacing) and custom-property tracing are confirmed. Free tools need no signup.

services.name: W3C DTCG format + Style Dictionary
services.company: Design Tokens Community Group / Style Dictionary OSS
services.what_it_does: DTCG released its first stable spec 2025.10 (JSON with $value/$type), and Figma, Adobe, Sketch and Framer ship compatible tokens. Style Dictionary (Apache-2.0) builds tokens into CSS/SCSS, iOS, Android and JS. v4 has first-class DTCG support and v5 is working on full 2025.10 support.
services.mechanism: Single source token JSON is transformed via platform formatters.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사별 시각 토큰의 '정식 저장 포맷'을 DTCG JSON으로 고정하세요. Style Dictionary로 웹(Tailwind/CSS 변수)과 문서(PPT 테마 색상표)로 동시에 배포하는 구조를 권장합니다.

verification.note: 2025.10 stable release confirmed. Style Dictionary v4 has DTCG support and full 2025.10 support is still in progress in v5.

services.name: Tokens Studio
services.what_it_does: Manages design tokens in Figma/Penpot and syncs them to GitHub and code via Style Dictionary. Has a CLI/SDK. About 300k plugin users.
services.mechanism: Token sets in the Figma plugin, Git sync, then Style Dictionary transforms.
services.integration: Figma, Penpot, GitHub, VS Code, Framer
services.pricing_status: Active; free trial plus paid plans
services.takeaway_for_crata: 추출한 DTCG 토큰을 고객사 디자이너가 Figma에서 직접 수정하고 다시 Git으로 돌려받는 '고객 검증 루프'용 도구입니다. 고객사에 디자인 조직이 있을 때만 도입하세요.

verification.note: Figma, Penpot, GitHub, Style Dictionary and CLI/SDK confirmed, plus 300k plugin users and a free trial. Country not stated on the site.

services.name: Figma (Variables REST API, Make kits, Figma agent skills)
services.what_it_does: The Variables REST API reads and writes variables (Enterprise plan only). Figma Make is prompt-to-app, and 'Make kits' import variables/styles from a design library plus guidelines as branded foundations. Figma agent 'skills' (Jul 2026) encode reusable standards such as UX writing and brand voice.
services.mechanism: Design-system context (variables, styles, components, guideline text) is injected into the AI agent, and skills are plain-English instruction sets.
services.integration: REST API, Plugin API, MCP server
services.korean_support: UI supports Korean; AI quality in Korean not confirmed
services.takeaway_for_crata: '디자인 시스템(컴포넌트) + 스킬(작성 규칙, 보이스)'을 분리하는 Figma의 구조는 CRATA Style Pack의 '토큰 + SKILL.md' 이원화와 같습니다. Variables API는 Enterprise 전용이라 고객사 Figma 원천 추출은 제한적입니다.

verification.note: The Variables REST API needs an Enterprise plan for both GET and POST (Full seat). Make kits import variables, styles and guidelines. The agent skills blog post (invoked with /) is dated 2026-07-01.

services.name: Google Stitch (+ stitch-skills / DESIGN.md)
services.what_it_does: Turns prompts, images, wireframes and screenshots into UI designs and front-end code (Gemini, launched May 2025), with Paste-to-Figma and code export. The stitch-skills repo generates DESIGN.md design-system docs, including 'extract-design-md' which scans /src to derive the design system.
services.mechanism: Multimodal LLM UI generation. DESIGN.md is a semantic design-system doc (colors, typography, components, tokens) reused by build skills.
services.integration: Web app, Stitch MCP server, agent skills (Claude Code/Cursor)
services.korean_support: Prompts in Korean possible; not officially stated
services.takeaway_for_crata: DESIGN.md는 'LLM이 읽는 디자인 시스템 문서'의 사실상 표준 후보입니다. CRATA Style Pack에도 DESIGN.md를 포함시키고, 고객사 기존 화면 스크린샷으로 업무 사이트 시안을 빠르게 만드는 데 쓰세요.

verification.note: Launched 2025-05-20 at I/O. The extract-design-md skill ("Scan /src ... into .stitch/DESIGN.md") is confirmed. The skills require the Stitch MCP server.

services.name: Lovable (Design systems, Build with URL)
services.what_it_does: Design systems package React components, design-system.json (tokens, component catalog) and system.md (guidelines), copied into projects as rules on all paid plans. 'Build with URL' fetches a public web page as a reference for layout, content and styling. Figma import is supported.
services.mechanism: File-copy attachment: components go to src/design-system/ and knowledge files to .lovable/rules/libraries/, which steer the agent.
services.integration: Web app, URL deep links, Figma, GitHub
services.korean_support: Korean prompts usable; not officially stated
services.pricing_status: Active; design systems on paid plans (npm wrapper Enterprise)
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사 업무 사이트 제작 엔진으로 가장 바로 쓸 만합니다. 'Style Pack → design-system.json/system.md 변환기'만 만들면 고객사마다 맞춤 포털 시안이 자동으로 나옵니다. Build with URL로 고객사 홈페이지를 레퍼런스로 지정하세요.

verification.note: design-system.json and system.md confirmed, available on all paid plans, with the npm-wrapper option Enterprise-only. Build with URL accepts an html= reference page and images. It only pre-fills the prompt; the build does not start automatically.

services.name: Vercel v0 (shadcn registry design systems)
services.what_it_does: Uses a shadcn registry as a distribution spec to pass design-system context to AI. Supports custom Tailwind config, globals.css tokens, fonts and 'Open in v0'. Design-system context is also available via MCP for Cursor/Windsurf.
services.mechanism: Registry JSON (components + CSS variables) is loaded into the generation context.
services.takeaway_for_crata: Dembrandt --shadcn 출력과 shadcn registry를 연결하면, 고객사 토큰이 적용된 컴포넌트 라이브러리를 코드로 재사용할 수 있습니다. 개발자 중심 고객사에 적합합니다.

verification.note: Registry, globals.css and tokens, Open in v0 and the MCP REGISTRY_URL setting are confirmed. However, the docs now call this the legacy registry-based guide and point to a newer 'Design Systems 2.0' workflow.

services.name: Relume (AI site builder: sitemap → wireframe → style)
services.what_it_does: Generates sitemap and wireframes from a brief (PDF upload supported) using 1,000+ human-built components, then exports to Figma, Webflow or React or publishes directly.
services.mechanism: LLM plans the sitemap/IA and assembles curated components, so there are no free-form hallucinated layouts.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 업무 사이트에서는 스타일보다 '정보구조(IA)'가 더 중요합니다. 'Plaud 회의·인터뷰 → 사이트맵 → 와이어프레임 → 스타일 적용'의 단계형 흐름을 벤치마크하세요.

verification.note: relume.io returns a 301 to relume.ai. Brief to sitemap to wireframe with 1,000+ components, export to Figma/Webflow/React and direct publishing are confirmed. It also offers a Relume Library MCP.

services.name: screenshot-to-code (open source)
services.what_it_does: Converts screenshots, mockups, Figma designs or screen recordings to HTML/Tailwind, React, Vue or Bootstrap code using Gemini, GPT or Claude models. Self-hostable.
services.mechanism: Multimodal LLM prompting with iterative refinement.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사가 쓰는 그룹웨어나 ERP 화면 스크린샷을 받아 '익숙한 화면 패턴'을 재현할 때 쓸 수 있습니다. 직원들이 이미 아는 UI 패턴을 업무 사이트에 이어받게 하면 도입 저항이 줄어듭니다.

verification.note: MIT, about 79.9k stars. HTML/Tailwind, React, Vue, Bootstrap and Ionic. Screen recordings can be used as input. Hosted version at screenshottocode.com.

services.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Brand Kit + SharePoint Brand Center
services.category: Office brand templates / AI deck generation
services.what_it_does: A Brand Kit holds .pptx/.potx templates, theme colors and fonts, images and brand voice/tone/style guidelines, and Copilot in PowerPoint uses it to keep generated slides on-brand. SharePoint Brand Center and the Organization Assets Library centralize fonts, images and .dotx/.potx/.xltx templates.
services.mechanism: Copilot analyzes sample slides, layouts and placeholders in the template plus the prompt. Microsoft guidance: define theme colors and fonts in the Slide Master, not manual styling.
relevant_features: Brand Kit (templates, colors, fonts, images, voice)
services.pricing_status: Active; Copilot licensing required; OAL in web needs E3/E5
services.takeaway_for_crata: M365를 쓰는 고객사라면 Style Pack 산출물로 '마스터에 테마색과 폰트가 정의된 .potx'를 만들어 Brand Kit에 올려 주는 것 자체가 AX 컨설팅의 결과물이 됩니다. '템플릿 정비'를 서비스 메뉴로 넣으세요.

verification.note: Brand Kit contents confirmed. The Organization Assets Library takes .dotx/.potx/.xltx templates. Showing the OAL and organization fonts in PowerPoint for the web needs an Office 365 E3/E5 license.

services.name: Templafy (Document Agents + MCP)
services.category: Document template management / agentic doc generation
services.what_it_does: Centralizes approved templates, brand guidelines and content libraries. Document Agents build proposals, reports and decks following company rules. Templafy MCP takes research from Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or Perplexity and returns a formatted, on-brand Office document.
services.mechanism: Rules-based template engine plus AI content, with templates, fonts, colors and assets applied automatically. Business rules and permissions are enforced.
services.integration: MCP, Office add-ins, Google Workspace, APIs
services.takeaway_for_crata: 'AI가 내용을 쓰고, 템플릿 엔진이 고객사 양식을 입힌다'는 분리 구조가 정답입니다. CRATA도 LLM이 doc-archetype JSON(구조화된 내용)을 내보내면 python-pptx, python-hwpx가 고객사 원본 템플릿에 채우는 방식으로 구현하세요.

verification.note: Templafy MCP turns output from Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or Perplexity into on-brand Office documents. 4M+ users confirmed.

services.name: Frontify (Brand guidelines portal, Brand Assistant, MCP)
services.what_it_does: Brand guidelines hub 'structured for humans, readable by AI', with DAM auto-tagging, Brand Assistant (Q&A and on-brand creation), guideline checking, locked templates and MCP access for AI agents.
services.mechanism: Structured guideline pages plus asset metadata exposed via API/MCP to agents.
services.integration: API, MCP, Figma, Adobe, HubSpot, Webflow
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사 업무 사이트 안에 '우리 회사 스타일 가이드' 페이지를 넣고 MCP로 AI가 읽게 하는 구조를 벤치마크하세요. 사람용 가이드와 AI용 컨텍스트를 하나의 원천에서 생성하는 것이 핵심입니다.

verification.note: "Structured for humans, readable by AI", DAM auto-tagging, Brand Assistant, locked templates and MCP/API access all confirmed.

services.name: Gamma (API + workspace themes)
services.what_it_does: Generates presentations, documents, webpages and social posts. The API supports generation from text or templates, workspace theme management, export and analytics.
services.mechanism: LLM content generation rendered with a selected workspace theme.
services.korean_support: Korean content generation possible (not officially detailed)
services.pricing_status: Active; API key needs a paid plan
services.takeaway_for_crata: 강의·워크샵 자료나 제안서 초안을 빠르게 뽑을 때, 고객사 테마를 워크스페이스 테마로 등록해 두고 API로 생성하는 방식이 가능합니다. 다만 한국 공공·학교 양식(HWP)은 대체할 수 없습니다.

verification.note: Generate from text or template, a /themes endpoint, PDF/PPTX export and analytics confirmed. An API key needs a Pro, Ultra, Teams or Business plan. OAuth is supported.

services.name: Canva (Brand templates + Autofill via Connect API)
services.what_it_does: The Connect API can publish designs as brand templates, list them, read a template's autofill dataset and autofill it with data. Requires a plan with brand templates (Pro/Teams/Enterprise).
services.mechanism: Template fields (dataset) are populated programmatically through the Autofill API.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 강의 홍보물이나 카드뉴스처럼 반복되는 고객사 디자인물은 Canva 브랜드 템플릿과 Autofill로 회의록에서 바로 생성하는 자동화가 현실적입니다.

verification.note: Publish, get, list and dataset endpoints for brand templates confirmed, plus Autofill. Requires Pro, Teams or Enterprise. The Connect APIs are now unified into the 'Canva Developers SDK'.

services.name: Anthropic Agent Skills — brand-guidelines (SKILL.md)
services.category: Agent skill format / brand style encoding
services.what_it_does: A SKILL.md that encodes brand colors (e.g., #141413, #faf9f5, accents), heading/body fonts with fallbacks (Poppins/Arial, Lora/Georgia) and application rules (font by size, accent cycling for shapes) for documents and slides.
services.mechanism: Markdown instructions plus frontmatter loaded by Claude when relevant, and applied while generating files.
services.integration: Claude apps / Claude Code / API skills
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사별 'brand-[회사명]' 스킬을 만들어 Claude/아라 에이전트가 문서와 슬라이드를 만들 때 자동으로 적용되게 하세요. 한글 폰트(예: Pretendard, 나눔고딕)의 대체 폰트 규칙도 함께 넣어야 합니다.

verification.note: Colors #141413/#faf9f5 with accents #d97757/#6a9bcc/#788c5d confirmed. Poppins→Arial for headings at 24pt and above, Lora→Georgia for body, and shapes cycle through the accent colors.

services.name: Upstage Document Parse
services.what_it_does: Converts PDFs, scans, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX and HWP/HWPX into structured HTML/Markdown with tables, charts and element coordinates, at about 0.6 s/page.
services.mechanism: Layout analysis model plus OCR, outputting typed elements (heading, table, figure, etc.) with coordinates.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 학교와 공공기관(학맞통 고객) 문서는 HWP가 다수라, 고객사 기존 문서 수백 건을 구조화해 '문서 유형과 섹션 패턴'을 통계적으로 뽑는 1차 파서로 가장 적합합니다.

verification.note: HWP/HWPX and Office formats, HTML/Markdown output with coordinates, $0.01/page, AWS/Azure/Snowflake and on-prem options confirmed. Upstage also offers an MCP server and Document Classification/Split APIs.

services.name: Hancom developer tools (hwpx-owpml-model) + python-hwpx (community)
services.what_it_does: Hancom's open-source hwpx-owpml-model (C++, Apache-2.0) reads and writes OWPML (HWPX) elements. Hancom also offers OCR, a document viewer/converter and Hangul automation. python-hwpx (Apache-2.0, v6.7.0) reads, edits and creates HWPX in pure Python with template filling.
services.mechanism: HWPX is ZIP+XML (OWPML). Parse style and formatting definitions plus section content, then fill templates.
services.integration: C++ libs, Python package, Hancom APIs
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사 HWPX 양식에서 글꼴, 문단 모양, 표 스타일, 결재란 구조를 뽑아 '양식 템플릿'으로 저장해 두세요. 그러면 LLM이 만든 내용을 고객사 원본 양식 그대로 채운 HWPX로 납품할 수 있습니다. 국내 경쟁 우위가 되는 부분입니다.

verification.note: hwpx-owpml-model: C++, Apache-2.0, reads and writes OWPML. python-hwpx: v6.7.0, Apache-2.0, maintained by airmang. Hancom developer site lists OCR, a document viewer/converter and Hangul OLE Automation.

services.name: KRDS (범정부 UI/UX 디자인 시스템)
services.what_it_does: Korean government digital design system with design tokens, HTML components (npm krds-uiux) and guidelines for consistency and accessibility in public services.
services.mechanism: Token + component kit distributed via npm/GitHub.
services.pricing_status: Active; KRDS terms of use (not a standard OSS license)
services.takeaway_for_crata: 학교나 교육청 대상 업무 사이트(학맞통)는 KRDS 토큰을 기본 베이스로 깔고, 기관 고유 색과 로고만 덮어쓰는 방식이 빠르고 접근성 기준도 충족합니다.

verification.note: Design tokens and an HTML component kit confirmed. npm krds-uiux latest is 1.1.0. Licensed under the KRDS terms of use, not a standard OSS license.

services.name: MiriCanvas (미리캔버스)
services.what_it_does: Korean design tool with 800k+ templates and AI presentation, writing, image, logo and video features, plus Enterprise and Education plans. A centralized brand-kit feature was not confirmed on official pages.
services.mechanism: Template library plus generative AI tools.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 국내 교사와 기업 실무자가 많이 쓰는 도구이지만 '고객사 스타일 자동 추출 및 적용' 기능은 확인되지 않습니다. 이 공백이 CRATA의 차별화 지점입니다. 강의·워크샵에서는 실습 도구로 활용하세요.

verification.note: The researcher said a brand kit was not confirmed. The official pricing FAQ says the Enterprise plan provides a 브랜드 키트 (brand kit), team drive, SSO and API integration. 800k+ templates and the AI features are confirmed.

methods.name: Style Pack 표준 (고객사별 스타일 패키지)
methods.description: One folder per client with: brand.tokens.json (W3C DTCG 2025.10), voice-card.json/.md, glossary.csv, doc-archetypes.json, original templates (.potx/.dotx/.hwpx), DESIGN.md (Stitch-style) and SKILL.md (Anthropic-style). Mirrors Lovable design-system.json+system.md, Microsoft Brand Kit and WRITER voice profile + terms + style guide.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 고객사 폴더 구조를 /clients/{회사}/style-pack/ 으로 고정하세요. (a) tokens.json (b) voice-card (c) glossary.csv (d) doc-archetypes.json (e) templates/ (f) DESIGN.md (g) SKILL.md 7종을 매 프로젝트의 필수 산출물로 정의합니다. 아라 에이전트, Lovable, Claude가 모두 이 폴더 하나만 읽도록 하는 것이 핵심입니다.

methods.name: 시각 토큰 추출 파이프라인 (URL → DTCG → 사이트 테마)
methods.description: Render the client's site with Playwright (Dembrandt) or Firecrawl branding/context.dev styleguide. Merge multiple pages and frequency-weight computed styles. Cluster near-duplicate colors and map them to semantic roles (primary/secondary/surface/text/success/error). Run a WCAG contrast check. Emit DTCG, then use Style Dictionary to produce CSS vars/Tailwind/shadcn and PPT theme colors.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 1) 홈페이지 5~10페이지를 dembrandt --dtcg --brand-guide로 추출하고 Firecrawl branding으로 교차검증합니다. 2) 상위 빈도 색과 폰트만 남기고 의미 역할을 사람이 확정합니다. 3) 고객 미팅에서 브랜드가이드 PDF로 확인받습니다. 4) shadcn/Tailwind 테마로 변환해 업무 사이트에, Slide Master 테마색으로 변환해 PPT 템플릿에 동시 적용합니다. 홈페이지가 낡은 고객사는 '로고 색 + KRDS 기본 토큰'으로 대체하세요.

methods.name: 톤·보이스 카드 도출 (정량 + LLM + 고객 검증)
methods.description: Build a corpus from website copy, past proposals and reports, notices, emails and meeting transcripts (with consent). Score NN/g's 4 tone dimensions (formal-casual, serious-funny, respectful-irreverent, matter-of-fact-enthusiastic), write Mailchimp-style 'We are X, not Y' voice pairs, and separate a constant voice from channel-specific tone. Add Korean axes quantified with a morphological analyzer (Kiwi): sentence-ending distribution (합니다/해요/개조식 -함·-음), honorific system, sentence length, Sino-Korean/loanword ratio, numbering style.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: voice-card.json 스키마 예시: {voice_pairs:[{we_are:'명료함', not:'과장'}], tone_by_channel:{내부보고:'개조식, -함/-음', 고객제안:'합니다체', 학부모안내:'해요체'}, nng_scores:{formal:0.8,...}, endings_dist, avg_sentence_len, banned_expressions, sample_rewrites:[before,after]}. LLM이 초안을 쓰고 Kiwi 통계로 근거를 붙인 뒤, 고객사 담당자가 '이건 우리 말투 맞다/아니다'를 표시하는 검증 세션(30분)을 컨설팅 단계에 넣으세요.

methods.name: 용어집(Glossary) 자동 구축 및 STT 연계
methods.description: Extract candidate nouns and noun phrases with Kiwi from client docs and meeting transcripts. Rank by frequency vs. a general corpus (TF-IDF-like). Have an LLM cluster variants into {preferred_term, variants, forbidden, definition, owner_team, example}. Export as CSV (Markup AI imports CSV/ACTIF XML) and reuse as STT custom vocabulary and as a classifier feature.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: glossary.csv 컬럼은 용어, 동의어·변형, 금지표현, 정의, 소속 사업·부서, 예문으로 둡니다. 같은 용어집을 (1) Plaud/STT 교정 사전, (2) 회의 자동분류(목표 A)의 키워드 신호, (3) 산출물 검수 규칙에 동시에 쓰세요. CRATA 내부(강의·워크샵/학맞통/아라)용 용어집부터 만들어 파일럿하면 목표 A와 B를 함께 검증할 수 있습니다.

methods.name: 문서 아키타입(Document Archetype) 추출 — PPTX/DOCX/HWPX
methods.description: Parse existing client documents. PPTX: slide master theme colors/fonts, layouts, placeholders. DOCX: styles. HWPX: OWPML ZIP+XML via python-hwpx/hwpx-owpml-model. Scans/PDF: Upstage Document Parse. Cluster documents by type and have an LLM derive section outlines, numbering schemes (1./가./1)), table styles, cover pages and approval blocks (결재란). Store as doc-archetypes.json plus the original template files. At generation time the LLM fills structured JSON and a template engine renders it into the original template (Templafy/Microsoft Brand Kit pattern).
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 고객사에서 '잘 된 문서' 20~50건(보고서, 기안, 제안서, 회의록, 가정통신문 등)을 받아 유형별로 군집화합니다. 유형마다 {doc_type, 섹션 순서, 번호 체계, 문체, 표 양식, 필수 요소(결재란·문서번호)}를 JSON으로 정리하세요. 생성은 'LLM → JSON → python-pptx/python-hwpx로 원본 템플릿에 채우기'로 분리해 양식이 깨지지 않게 합니다. M365 고객사는 마스터를 정비한 .potx를 Copilot Brand Kit에도 등록해 주세요.

methods.name: 생성-검수 분리 (Guardian Agent) 및 드리프트 관리
methods.description: Separate generation from verification. After any output, a checker agent scores it against the Style Pack: banned/preferred terms, sentence endings, tone scores, color tokens and template conformance. It flags violations and suggests rewrites (Markup AI Content Guardian Agents, Jasper violation flagging). For the site, compare tokens against a baseline in CI to detect design drift (Dembrandt).
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 아라 에이전트에 'style-check' 도구(MCP)를 붙여 모든 산출물에 '스타일 적합도 점수'와 위반 목록을 함께 출력하게 하세요. 이 점수 추이는 AX 컨설팅의 성과 지표(KPI)로도 쓸 수 있습니다.

methods.name: 회의 기반 조직 패턴 학습 (Enterprise Brain형)
methods.description: Beyond static style, capture how the company decides and works from meetings and chat: recurring decisions, approval paths, reviewers' preferences, recurring document requests. Structure them into a context graph/agent memory (WRITER Enterprise Brain from WRITER Meet/Slack/Teams). Figma agent skills similarly encode a stakeholder's feedback style as a reusable skill.
methods.how_to_apply_ko: Plaud 녹음 분류(목표 A) 결과에서 '결정사항, 요청 산출물 유형, 상급자 피드백 패턴'을 별도 필드로 뽑아 고객사 컨텍스트 그래프에 누적하세요. 이 데이터로 업무 사이트의 메뉴(자주 요청되는 문서), 워크플로(결재 경로), 'OO 팀장 스타일 피드백' 스킬을 자동으로 만들 수 있습니다.

methods.name: Style Pack → 업무 사이트 생성 (디자인 시스템 우선 주입)
methods.description: AI site builders perform best when design-system context is injected first: Lovable design-system.json/system.md and Build with URL, a v0 shadcn registry, Stitch DESIGN.md, Figma Make kits. Use Relume's staged flow (brief → sitemap → wireframe → style) for IA, and screenshot-to-code to mirror familiar internal-tool patterns (groupware/ERP).
methods.how_to_apply_ko: 순서는 ① 인터뷰·회의로 사이트맵(IA) 확정 ② KRDS 또는 shadcn 베이스에 고객 토큰 덮어쓰기 ③ Lovable에 design-system.json과 고객 홈페이지 URL을 레퍼런스로 넣어 시안 생성 ④ 고객사 그룹웨어 스크린샷으로 익숙한 패턴 반영 ⑤ 사이트 안에 '스타일 가이드' 페이지와 MCP 엔드포인트를 두어 고객사 AI 도구도 같은 원천을 읽게 합니다.

claim_verdicts.claim: Firecrawl's scrape endpoint supports formats:['branding'], returning colors, fonts, typography, spacing, components, logo, layout and a 'personality' field. Branding Format v2 was published 2026-02-06.
claim_verdicts.correction: The docs also list images (logo, favicon, OG), animations and color-scheme detection. The v2 post is mainly about better logo extraction.

claim_verdicts.claim: brand.dev now redirects to context.dev, whose docs list an 'Extract a styleguide' endpoint (colors, typography, spacing, component styles) plus a Screenshot endpoint.
claim_verdicts.source: https://brand.dev returns a 301 to https://www.context.dev/ ; https://docs.context.dev/llms.txt
claim_verdicts.correction: context.dev now covers far more than brand data: scrape, crawl, search, people enrichment, news, file parsing and monitors.

claim_verdicts.claim: Dembrandt (MIT) extracts design tokens from any website via Playwright and outputs W3C DTCG, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui themes and a brand-guide PDF, with MCP integration.
claim_verdicts.source: https://github.com/thevangelist/dembrandt (MIT, about 3.6k stars, v0.37.0, MCP tools get_design_tokens and compute_drift)

claim_verdicts.claim: The W3C Design Tokens Community Group released its first stable format version, 2025.10. Style Dictionary v4 has first-class DTCG support and v5 is still completing 2025.10 support.
claim_verdicts.source: https://www.designtokens.org/ ; https://styledictionary.com/info/dtcg/ ("2025.10 does not have full support yet... work in progress in v5")
claim_verdicts.correction: DTCG is a W3C Community Group, so 2025.10 is a stable community spec, not a W3C Recommendation.

claim_verdicts.claim: Acrolinx is now Markup AI ('Content Guardian Agents'), offering Style, Brand Terms (CSV/ACTIF XML import), Brand Voice and Persona agents plus an MCP server.
claim_verdicts.source: https://www.acrolinx.com/ (banner: "Acrolinx is now Markup AI. Same standards, new Content Guardian Agents") ; https://docs.markup.ai/llms.txt
claim_verdicts.correction: The docs list about 15 agents in total (claims, dates, freshness, AI detection and more), not only these four.

claim_verdicts.claim: WRITER lets admins attach terminology lists and style guides to voice profiles (May 2026). WRITER Enterprise Brain (announced 2026-09-09) captures decisions and preferences from WRITER Meet/Slack/Teams into a shared context graph.
claim_verdicts.correction: The May 2026 voice-profile part is confirmed. On Enterprise Brain, the post says Agent Memory structures "sessions and conversations in WRITER Meet" into a shared context graph. Slack and Teams are places where users talk to WRITER Agent, but the post does not say they feed the graph. WRITER for Teams is still in early access. The brand, compliance and content-library parts were only starting to roll out on 2026-09-09.

claim_verdicts.claim: The Microsoft 365 Copilot Brand Kit contains PowerPoint templates (.pptx/.potx), theme colors/fonts, images and brand voice/tone/style guidelines, which Copilot uses to keep generated slides on-brand.
claim_verdicts.correction: The page does not name a license tier. It only says Brand Kit may not be included in your subscription.

claim_verdicts.claim: Upstage Document Parse accepts HWP/HWPX, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, PDF and images, outputs HTML/Markdown with element coordinates, and costs about $0.01 per page via API.
claim_verdicts.source: https://console.upstage.ai/docs/capabilities/parse/input-requirements.md (formats include HWP, HWPX, DOC/DOCX, PPT/PPTX, XLS/XLSX, CSV, PDF and images) ; https://www.upstage.ai/products/document-parse ($0.01/page, 0.6 s/page)
claim_verdicts.correction: Limits: 100 pages per synchronous call and 2,000 pages per asynchronous call.

summary_ko:
1) 'CRATA가 원하는 방향'과 가장 닮은 제품은 Microsoft Power Apps Plans입니다. 자연어 업무 설명, 프로세스 다이어그램, 기존 앱 스크린샷을 넣으면 Requirement Agent가 역할과 요구사항을, Data Agent가 테이블과 관계를, Solution Agent가 앱·플로우·에이전트 구성을 차례로 만듭니다. 2026년 기준 GA입니다. Zoho Creator도 Plan Agent(요구사항서 BRD 작성) → Build Agent 구조이고, GitHub Spec Kit도 constitution → specify → plan → tasks → implement 순서로 같은 틀을 씁니다. 즉 '요구사항 → 데이터모델 → 화면·워크플로우'를 단계별로 확정하고, 단계마다 사람이 승인하는 방식이 업계 표준이 되었습니다.
2) '회사 스타일'은 이제 디자인시스템을 AI가 쓰는 스킬이나 어댑터로 등록하는 방식으로 처리합니다. v0 Design Systems 2.0(스킬), Lovable 디자인시스템(생성 결과의 위반 자동 스캔), Figma Make kits와 첨부(브랜드 가이드), Bolt Teams(패키지별 프롬프트), Claude Design(/design-sync)이 모두 이 방식입니다. CRATA도 고객사마다 'DTCG 표준 토큰 + shadcn 레지스트리 + 톤·용어 규칙'을 하나의 스킬 패키지로 만들면 됩니다.
3) 스타일 추출 자동화의 출발점으로 Firecrawl branding 포맷을 쓸 수 있습니다. 웹사이트에서 색·폰트·간격·버튼 스타일·브랜드 성격을 JSON으로 뽑아 줍니다. 디자인 토큰 표준 DTCG는 2025.10에 첫 안정판이 나왔습니다. 다만 '일하는 패턴'(결재선, 문서 양식, 용어, 회의 문화)은 웹에서 뽑을 수 없습니다. 회의록, 내부 문서, 그룹웨어 데이터를 바탕으로 Palantir 온톨로지식(객체·관계·액션) 프로필로 정리해야 합니다.
4) 생성 방식은 세 갈래이고, 고객사의 보안 수준과 운영 역량에 따라 고릅니다.
 - 코드 생성형(Claude Code/Agent SDK, Lovable, v0 → Next.js+Supabase, 서울 리전 가능): 소유권과 커스터마이징에 유리합니다.
 - 노코드형(Softr, Glide, Airtable, Bubble, Zite, Noloco): 고객사가 직접 유지보수하기 쉽습니다.
 - 오픈소스 셀프호스팅형(Appsmith, Budibase, Refine): 학교·공공 등 망분리나 보안 요구가 있을 때 맞습니다.
5) 2026년의 주요 변화는 다음과 같습니다.
 - Airtable이 2026-09-04 Bending Spoons에 인수되었습니다(장기 의존 리스크).
 - Firebase Studio는 2026-06-22부터 신규 생성이 막혔고, 2027-03-22에 종료됩니다.
 - Power Apps vibe(코드 생성형)는 프리뷰이고 영어만 지원하며, 앱 빌딩은 Copilot Cowork/Copilot Studio로 이동 중입니다.
 - Retool은 2026-06에 React/TypeScript 코드를 생성하는 빌더를 출시했고, Claude Code·Lovable·v0에서 만든 앱도 가져올 수 있습니다.
 - Softr Agents(2026-08)와 Softr MCP(2026-09)가 나왔습니다.
 - Notion은 회의록이 Custom Agent를 자동 실행하는 트리거(2026-07-31)를 추가했습니다.
6) 국내 그룹웨어(네이버웍스, 두레이, 플로우, 다우오피스 Works, Swit)는 포털을 '생성'하는 도구라기보다, 만든 포털을 배포하고 연동하는 대상으로 보는 것이 맞습니다. 플로우는 API/MCP를, 다우오피스는 Works 앱빌더를, 두레이와 네이버웍스는 CSAP·공공 대응을 강점으로 내세웁니다. 아임웹과 카페24는 홈페이지·쇼핑몰 빌더라서 사내 업무포털 생성에는 맞지 않습니다(AI 기능은 이번 조사에서 사이트 접근이 막혀 확인하지 못했습니다).
7) 권장 파이프라인: Company Profile YAML(조직·역할, 온톨로지, 프로세스·결재, 문서 템플릿, 용어·톤, DTCG 토큰, 연동, 보안 제약) → Claude Agent SDK 기반 'Plan→Data→Solution' 다단계 생성(단계마다 사람 승인) → CRATA 고정 베이스 템플릿 위에 생성. 베이스 템플릿은 Next.js + Supabase Seoul + 인증·권한(RLS) 고정 계층 + 고객사별 shadcn 테마입니다. 노코드를 원하는 고객사에는 같은 YAML을 Softr/Glide/Power Apps용 프롬프트로 바꿔 넣습니다.

services.name: Microsoft Power Apps – Plans (Plan designer) + Power Apps vibe
services.what_it_does: Describe a business process in natural language (plus process diagrams, data models, legacy app screenshots) and Plans generates a full Power Platform solution: Dataverse tables, canvas/model-driven apps, Power Pages sites, Power Automate flows, Power BI, Copilot Studio agents.
services.mechanism: Three plan agents in sequence: Requirement Agent (user roles + user needs) → Data Agent (tables, columns, types, relationships) → Solution Agent (proposes apps/flows/agents mapped to roles and tables); human 'Looks good/Edit' gate at each step; plan exportable to PDF. 'vibe' preview generates code apps with plan+data+app in one workspace.
relevant_features: Requirements→Data model→Solution staged generation with approval gates
Plan export to PDF for stakeholders
vibe: optional Anthropic models; preview, English only, US/Australia/Asia/India regions
App building moving to Copilot Cowork / Copilot Studio
services.integration: Dataverse, Power Automate connectors, Copilot Studio, M365
services.korean_support: Plans: locale/geography-dependent (Korean support not confirmed); vibe: English only
services.pricing_status: Plans GA and enabled by default (doc updated 2026-08); vibe in preview (doc 2026-09)
services.takeaway_for_crata: CRATA 생성기의 '설계 원형'으로 삼기에 가장 좋습니다. 요구사항(역할·니즈) → 데이터모델 → 솔루션 구성의 3단계와 단계별 승인, PDF 보고서 출력을 그대로 따라 하면 됩니다. 고객사가 M365를 쓰는 대기업이면 Plans로 직접 생성해 납품하는 경로도 가능합니다.

verification.note: Plans is GA and enabled by default (doc 2026-08-07). It accepts process-flow images and legacy screenshots and exports to PDF. Vibe is preview-only (doc 2026-09-08). App building is live in Copilot Cowork, with Copilot Studio 'soon'.

services.name: Retool (AI app builder, Assist, Retool Agents)
services.what_it_does: Generates full-stack internal apps on live production data (Postgres, Databricks, Salesforce…) scaffolded from real schema, roles and permissions; June 2026 builder outputs React frontend + TypeScript backend; Retool Agents for autonomous agents.
services.mechanism: Schema-grounded scaffolding plus context-aware edits (click component / @mention resource); centralized governance layer (auth, RBAC, data policies) sits outside app code; imports React apps built in Claude Code, Replit, Lovable, v0 and maps data connections to governed resources.
relevant_features: React/TS output, Code tab and Data tab
MCP server and CLI to build/edit Retool apps from Claude Code
Deploy on Retool Cloud, customer VPC or on-prem
services.integration: REST, MCP, CLI, 12 SI/consultancy partners, Salesforce/Stripe/etc.
services.pricing_status: Active. Free (5 users), Team $10–12/builder + $5–7/internal user, Business $50–65/builder + $15–18/user, Enterprise custom; self-hosting on all tiers
services.takeaway_for_crata: '거버넌스(인증·권한·데이터 정책)는 앱 코드 밖의 공통 계층에 두고, 생성되는 것은 화면과 로직뿐'이라는 구조를 CRATA 베이스 템플릿에 그대로 적용할 수 있습니다. 데이터가 큰 중견기업 고객이라면 Claude Code로 만든 앱을 Retool로 이관해 운영하는 하이브리드도 선택지입니다.

verification.note: Confirmed: apps scaffolded from real schema, roles and permissions; React/TS output; MCP server; Cloud/VPC/on-prem deployment; Agents billed by runtime, with rates varying by model. Pricing confirmed: Team $10/$12 builder + $5/$7 user, Business $50/$65 + $15/$18, self-hosting on all tiers. A Retool CLI was not verified on primary pages.

services.name: Lovable (+ Lovable Cloud, Design Systems, Build with URL)
services.what_it_does: Generates full-stack web apps (frontend, backend, DB, auth, integrations) from natural language with editable code synced to GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket; used for internal tools and dashboards.
services.mechanism: Lovable Cloud built on Supabase (DB, auth, storage, edge functions, cron); workspace 'design system' projects copy React components into src/design-system/ and scan every generation for violations (raw colors, custom components, inline overrides); Build with URL pre-fills prompts (≤50k chars) + reference images/HTML.
relevant_features: Design system projects with version updates and violation scanning
Cloud regions: Americas/Europe/Asia Pacific (fixed after enabling)
Build with URL for templated project starts
SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, SSO, audit logs
services.integration: GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket sync, Supabase connector, Lovable MCP server, Lovable API
services.korean_support: English UI; Korean prompts possible via LLM (not officially stated)
services.pricing_status: Active. Free (5 daily credits), Pro/Business credit plans, Enterprise; design systems on all paid plans, npm-wrapped DS Enterprise-only
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사마다 'Lovable 디자인시스템 프로젝트'를 하나씩 만들어 두고, Company Profile YAML을 프롬프트로 바꿔 Build with URL로 주입하는 방식이 가장 빨리 구현할 수 있는 경로입니다. 단, Lovable Cloud는 리전을 바꿀 수 없고 자체 Supabase로 원클릭 이전도 안 되므로, 보안이 중요한 고객은 처음부터 자체 Supabase(서울)에 연결하세요.

verification.note: Design systems are on all paid plans, npm-wrapped ones are Enterprise-only, and violation scanning and versioning are confirmed. Sync to GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket, the MCP server, SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 are confirmed. Free tier gives 5 daily credits (max 30/mo) and unlimited members. Build with URL only prefills a prompt: the build starts only when the user clicks send.

services.name: v0 (Vercel) – Design Systems 2.0 + Platform API
services.what_it_does: Generates Next.js/Tailwind/shadcn apps from prompts, with GitHub branching/PR workflow, one-click DBs (Supabase, Neon, Upstash), deployment on Vercel.
services.mechanism: Design Systems 2.0 saves a team design system as a 'skill' — an adapter listing safe components, props and tokens from npm/GitHub/Figma/docs — and a starter app (v0.json) every new app starts from; Platform API lets you create chats/projects and deploy programmatically.
relevant_features: Design system as reusable skill + starter app
MCP integrations (Notion, Linear, etc.) and v0 as MCP server
services.integration: REST Platform API/SDK, MCP, GitHub, Vercel, Supabase/Neon
services.korean_support: English UI; Korean prompts via LLM (not officially stated)
services.pricing_status: Active; API quotas (e.g., 10,000 daily requests); enterprise via sales
services.takeaway_for_crata: '디자인시스템 = 스킬(어댑터) + 스타터 앱' 구조를 그대로 차용하세요. 고객사별로 shadcn 레지스트리와 스타터 앱을 만들고 v0 Platform API로 YAML 기반 생성을 자동화하면, 반복 가능한 생성 파이프라인이 됩니다.

verification.note: Platform API confirmed (v0.chats.create; daily quota of 10,000 API requests). v0 supports MCP (Notion, Linear presets) and can act as an MCP server. Git branch/commit workflow and one-click Supabase/Neon/Upstash are confirmed. SSO, SCIM and Directory Sync are on Enterprise.

services.name: Claude Code / Claude Agent SDK / Claude Artifacts / Claude Design
services.category: Coding agent + agent SDK + shareable app pages + design tool
services.what_it_does: Agent SDK exposes Claude Code's agent loop, tools, hooks, subagents, MCP, skills and plugins in Python/TypeScript; Artifacts publish small AI-powered apps with persistent storage and connector access; Claude Design builds on-brand assets from design systems pulled from GitHub, design files or uploads.
services.mechanism: Skills/plugins package company-specific instructions; subagents split stages (requirements, data, UI); Claude Design ingests design systems and syncs them into Claude Code via /design-sync; Artifacts call Claude directly without API keys and can store shared data.
relevant_features: Agent SDK: skills, subagents, hooks, MCP, sessions
Artifacts: AI-powered, persistent storage, shared within Team/Enterprise orgs
Claude Design: extract/apply design systems, export PPTX/PDF/HTML, /design-sync to Claude Code
services.integration: Python/TS SDK, MCP, CLI headless (-p, JSON output), GitHub
services.korean_support: Korean input/output supported by the model; UI localized partially (not verified)
services.pricing_status: Active; Agent SDK via API key under Commercial Terms; Artifacts on all plans, storage/connectors on paid plans
services.takeaway_for_crata: CRATA 생성기의 '엔진'으로 가장 적합합니다. Company Profile YAML을 읽는 스킬, 단계별 서브에이전트(요구사항/데이터/UI/검증), 고객사 디자인시스템 스킬을 플러그인으로 묶으면 고객사마다 재사용할 수 있습니다. 시제품은 Artifacts로 바로 공유해 검증받고, 확정되면 Next.js+Supabase로 내보내는 2단계 납품이 가능합니다.

verification.note: SDK capabilities confirmed (tools, hooks, subagents, MCP, sessions, skills, plugins), as are Commercial Terms, API-key auth, Managed Agents and the -p JSON headless mode. Artifacts are on all plans, but storage and app connections are paid plans only, on web/desktop. New AI-powered artifacts require permission. Claude Design is on all paid plans (org admin must enable), imports design systems from GitHub, design files or uploads, and supports PPTX/PDF/HTML export and /design-sync.

services.name: Airtable (Omni AI app builder)
services.what_it_does: Omni conversational builder creates complete apps — tables, interfaces, automations — from a description plus attached briefs/notes; everything remains editable.
services.mechanism: LLM converts description + attachments into base schema, interface pages and automation logic; AI-native relaunch June 24, 2025; Airtable for ChatGPT (Dec 2025).
services.korean_support: Data in Korean fine; UI English (not verified)
services.pricing_status: Active; acquired by Bending Spoons (announced Sep 4, 2026)
services.takeaway_for_crata: '브리프·회의록을 첨부하면 앱이 나온다'는 UX는 참고할 만합니다. 다만 Bending Spoons 인수 이후 가격·정책이 바뀔 위험이 있으므로, 고객사 핵심 포털의 장기 기반으로 쓰는 것은 신중해야 합니다.

verification.note: Bending Spoons completed the acquisition on Sep 4, 2026. That date is when the deal closed, not when it was announced. Omni builds tables, interfaces and automations, accepts briefs and meeting notes as attachments, and its output is fully editable (confirmed).

services.name: Softr (AI app generator, Softr Agents, Softr MCP)
services.what_it_does: From a prompt, generates pages, database, user groups/permissions, workflows and auth for a secure business app or client/internal portal.
services.mechanism: Prompt → native Softr Database schema + page blocks + permission rules + workflows; can sit on Airtable, Google Sheets, Notion, HubSpot, monday, SQL/Supabase; 2026 adds Agents (Aug) and MCP (Sep) so external agents like Claude Code can build/run apps on Softr.
relevant_features: Generates permissions/user groups, not just UI
Guides on building with Claude Code and running on Softr
services.pricing_status: Active; free start, paid tiers (details not retrieved)
services.takeaway_for_crata: 코딩 유지보수가 어려운 중소기업·학교 고객용 '노코드 납품 경로'로 쓸 수 있습니다. 같은 Company Profile YAML을 Softr MCP로 넘겨 포털을 만들면, 고객사 담당자가 직접 수정하며 운영할 수 있습니다.

verification.note: Generates pages, database, permissions and workflows from a prompt (confirmed). MCP, Agents and Supabase/Postgres are confirmed. The About page describes a remote-first team with no stated HQ, so the Germany attribution is unverified.

services.name: Zoho Creator (Plan Agent, Build Agent, Test Agent)
services.what_it_does: Plan Agent turns an idea into a business requirement document (BRD), Build Agent adds modules/workflows, Test Agent generates and self-heals test cases.
services.mechanism: Requirements document as the intermediate artifact before building; Zia assistant for fields/workflows; BYO LLM key (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic).
services.takeaway_for_crata: '요구사항서(BRD)를 먼저 만들고 고객 승인을 받은 뒤 빌드'하는 흐름은 CRATA 컨설팅 산출물과 그대로 맞물립니다. BRD를 Company Profile의 업무 프로세스 섹션 형식으로 표준화해 두면 좋습니다. 테스트 에이전트도 품질관리 단계로 벤치마킹할 만합니다.

verification.note: Plan Agent (BRD), Build Agent and Test Agent with self-healing tests are confirmed. BYO key from OpenAI, Google or Anthropic is confirmed.

services.name: Bolt.new (Bolt Cloud, Teams design systems)
services.what_it_does: Generates and hosts web apps with Bolt Cloud (unlimited DBs, auth, hosting, custom domains); Teams plan adds design-system knowledge.
services.mechanism: Teams: private NPM registries + 'design system knowledge with per-package prompts' so generation uses company components.
services.pricing_status: Active. Free, Pro $25/mo, Teams $30/member/mo, Enterprise custom
services.takeaway_for_crata: '패키지마다 사용 규칙 프롬프트를 붙이는' 방식은 CRATA 디자인시스템 스킬 문서를 짤 때 참고할 수 있습니다. 주 생성 도구로는 Lovable·v0·Claude Code와 겹치므로 우선순위는 낮습니다.

verification.note: Operated by StackBlitz. Pricing confirmed: Free, Pro $25, Teams $30/member, Enterprise custom. Teams adds 'Design System knowledge with per-package prompts' and private NPM registries. Bolt Cloud DB, auth, hosting and custom domains confirmed.

services.name: Replit Agent
services.what_it_does: Agent plans, builds, tests and deploys apps; pulls data from BigQuery, Linear, Slack, Notion; creates checkpoints for rollback.
services.mechanism: Autonomous agent with self-testing and checkpoints; effort-based pricing.
relevant_features: Enterprise single-tenant, SSO, static outbound IPs
services.takeaway_for_crata: 자체 테스트와 체크포인트 롤백 개념은 생성 파이프라인 품질관리에 참고할 만합니다. 고객사 납품 기반으로는 소유권과 국내 호스팅 측면에서 Next.js+Supabase 직접 생성보다 장점이 적습니다.

verification.note: Plan/build/test/deploy, checkpoints and connectors (BigQuery, Linear, Slack, Notion) are confirmed. Core is $20/mo ($18 annual) and Pro $100/mo ($90 annual). Enterprise offers single-tenant, SSO and static outbound IPs.

services.name: Figma Make (Make kits, attachments)
services.what_it_does: Generates functional prototypes/web apps from prompts using a team's real design system (Make kits, npm packages, library styles) and attached context (brand guidelines, data, screenshots).
services.mechanism: Make kits bring components/styles into generation from first prompt; Make attachments add project-specific brand/data context; canvas↔code round-trip.
relevant_features: Make kits = design system for AI
services.takeaway_for_crata: 고객사에 Figma 디자인시스템이 있으면 Make kit으로 가져와 화면 시안을 빠르게 검증받는 단계에 쓰세요. 대부분의 국내 중소기업은 디자인시스템이 없으므로, CRATA가 직접 추출(Firecrawl → DTCG 토큰)하는 쪽이 현실적입니다.

verification.note: Make kits (npm packages, library styles, guidelines), attachments (images, PDFs, text), MCP connectors and a 'Coming soon' local codebase mode are confirmed. The blog post is dated May 28, 2026.

services.name: Google Stitch / Firebase Studio
services.what_it_does: Stitch (Google Labs, May 2025) turns text/images into UI designs + frontend code, exports to Figma or code. Firebase Studio's App Prototyping agent built Next.js apps.
services.mechanism: Gemini multimodal generation; multiple variants; paste-to-Figma.
relevant_features: Firebase Studio: new workspaces disabled 2026-06-22, sunset 2027-03-22 (migrate to Google AI Studio / Antigravity)
services.pricing_status: Stitch: Labs experiment; Firebase Studio: sunsetting March 22, 2027
services.takeaway_for_crata: Stitch는 고객사의 기존 화면 스크린샷을 UI 시안으로 바꾸는 보조 도구로만 가치가 있습니다. Firebase Studio는 종료 예정이므로 도입하지 마세요.

verification.note: Firebase Studio is sunsetting: new workspaces and signups were disabled on 2026-06-22, and it shuts down on 2027-03-22 (migrate to AI Studio or Antigravity). Stitch launched May 20, 2025 as a Google Labs experiment with Figma paste and code export. Its current (2026) Labs status could not be verified.

services.name: Relume
services.category: AI sitemap / wireframe / style guide generator
services.what_it_does: Turns a brief into sitemap → wireframes → style guide, assembling sites from 1,000+ human-designed components; publish or export to Figma, Webflow, React; Relume Library MCP.
services.mechanism: LLM plans the information architecture, then maps sections to a curated component library instead of free-form generation.
relevant_features: Brief → sitemap → wireframe → style guide pipeline
services.takeaway_for_crata: '브리프 → 사이트맵 → 와이어프레임 → 스타일가이드' 단계 분리와 '검증된 컴포넌트 조합' 방식은 CRATA 업무포털 정보구조(메뉴·페이지) 설계 단계에 그대로 적용할 수 있습니다. 다만 마케팅 사이트용이라 업무 앱 로직은 없습니다.

services.name: Palantir Foundry / AIP Ontology (+ Workshop)

services.korean_support: Enterprise deployments in Korea exist (not verified here)

services.name: Firecrawl (branding format)

services.mechanism: Rendered-page analysis returning structured JSON; combinable with markdown/screenshot formats.
services.takeaway_for_crata: 목표 B의 '스타일 추출' 1단계를 자동화하는 핵심 부품입니다. 고객사 홈페이지·채용페이지·IR 자료 URL을 넣어 JSON을 받고, 이를 DTCG 토큰으로 바꿔 shadcn 테마에 주입하면 '그 회사 같아 보이는' 포털이 바로 나옵니다.

verification.note: Branding fields confirmed, including personality (tone, energy, target audience). SDKs exist for Python, Node, Go, Rust, Java and Elixir.

services.name: Samsung SDS FabriX
